name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot is an inbound marketing, sales, and customer service platform integrating CRM, email automation, and analytics to facilitate lead nurturing and seamless customer experiences

tools.name: Add asset association
tools.description: Associates an existing asset ('FORM', 'OBJECT_LIST', or 'EXTERNAL_WEB_URL') with a specified HubSpot marketing campaign.

tools.name: Add token to event template
tools.description: Adds a new custom data token to an existing event template for a specified HubSpot application, optionally populating a CRM object property if objectPropertyName is provided.

tools.name: Archive email
tools.description: Archives the HubSpot email specified by `emailId` by moving it to the recycling bin, making it inaccessible unless restored.

tools.name: Archive a batch of quotes by id
tools.description: Archives a batch of existing quotes by their IDs, removing them from active views while keeping them accessible in your HubSpot account for viewing, downloading, cloning, or deletion; note that archived quotes cannot be restored to active status.

tools.name: Archive batch of feedback submissions by id
tools.description: Asynchronously archives a batch of HubSpot feedback submissions using their unique IDs, which must correspond to valid and existing submissions; the operation is queued, and submissions are moved from active views without being deleted.

tools.name: Archive batch of line items by id
tools.description: Archives a batch of existing line items by their unique IDs in HubSpot CRM; this operation is irreversible via the API.

tools.name: Archive batch of objects by id
tools.description: Archives a batch of existing, non-archived CRM objects of a specified `objectType` by their IDs, effectively hiding them from active use.

tools.name: Archive batch of properties
tools.description: Archives a batch of properties by their internal names for a specified HubSpot CRM object type; this operation is idempotent and safe to retry.

tools.name: Archive companies
tools.description: Archives multiple HubSpot companies by their IDs.

tools.name: Archive company
tools.description: Archives an existing company in HubSpot CRM by its `companyId`, moving it to a recycling bin from which it can be restored, rather than permanently deleting it.

tools.name: Archive contact
tools.description: Archives a HubSpot contact by its ID.

tools.name: Archive contacts
tools.description: Archives multiple HubSpot contacts by their IDs.

tools.name: Archive a CRM object by ID
tools.description: Archives a specific HubSpot CRM object by its type and ID, moving it to the recycling bin; this action is irreversible via the API but objects can often be restored via the HubSpot UI.

tools.name: Archive deals
tools.description: Archives multiple HubSpot deals by their IDs.

tools.name: Archive emails
tools.description: Archives multiple HubSpot emails by their IDs.

tools.name: Archive feedback submission
tools.description: Archives an existing, non-archived Feedback Submission in HubSpot CRM by its ID, moving it to the recycling bin (not permanently deleting it).

tools.name: Archive line item by id
tools.description: Archives a specific HubSpot line item by its ID, moving it to a recoverable state.

tools.name: Archive product
tools.description: Archives a HubSpot product by its ID.

tools.name: Archive products
tools.description: Archives multiple HubSpot products by their IDs.

tools.name: Archive property by object type and name
tools.description: Archives a specified CRM property by its object type and name, moving it to the recycling bin; note that some default HubSpot properties cannot be archived.

tools.name: Archive property group
tools.description: Archives a HubSpot property group, making it inactive and hidden (not permanently deleted, allowing potential restoration) with immediate effect on its CRM visibility and usability.

tools.name: Archive quote object by id
tools.description: Archives a HubSpot Quote object by ID, moving it to the recycling bin where it can be restored within 90 days.

tools.name: Archive ticket
tools.description: Archives a HubSpot ticket by its ID.

tools.name: Archive tickets
tools.description: Archives multiple HubSpot tickets by their IDs.

tools.name: Audit pipeline changes by id
tools.description: Retrieves a reverse chronological audit log of all changes for a specific, existing HubSpot CRM pipeline, which is identified by its `pipelineId` and a valid `objectType` that supports pipelines (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets').

tools.name: Batch read companies by properties
tools.description: Batch-retrieves up to 100 HubSpot company records by their IDs in a single request. Supports custom ID properties (e.g., domain), selective property retrieval, and historical property values.

tools.name: Batch update quotes
tools.description: Updates multiple existing HubSpot quotes in a batch; each quote is identified by its object ID or a custom unique property (via `idProperty`), and only writable properties are modified.

tools.name: Cancel active import
tools.description: Cancels an active HubSpot data import job using its `importId`; this action is irreversible, and any data already processed will remain.

tools.name: Clone marketing email
tools.description: Duplicates an existing HubSpot marketing email, identified by its `id`, into a new draft; an optional `cloneName` can be assigned to this new email copy.

tools.name: Configure calling extension settings
tools.description: Configures or updates settings for a HubSpot app's calling extension, including its name, UI URL, iframe dimensions, `isReady` status, and `supportsCustomObjects` flag, for the specified `appId`.

tools.name: Create A/B test variation
tools.description: Creates a new A/B test variation for an existing HubSpot marketing email, using its `contentId`; the new variation is created as a draft that can be edited before publishing. This action only creates the variation—it does not start the A/B test or send emails. Note: If an active variation already exists for the email, a new one will not be created. Requires Marketing Hub Professional or Enterprise subscription.

tools.name: Create a new property group
tools.description: Creates a new, empty property group for a specified CRM object type in HubSpot, requiring a unique group name for that object type; properties must be added separately.

tools.name: Create a new marketing email
tools.description: Creates a new marketing email in HubSpot, allowing comprehensive configuration of content, recipients, sender details, A/B testing, scheduling, web version, and other settings; the internal `name` for the email is required.

tools.name: Create association for object type
tools.description: Creates a new custom association definition (schema) for a custom object in HubSpot, specifying how this object type can relate to another object type; this defines the association type itself, not actual record-to-record links. Note: This endpoint requires crm.schemas.custom.write scope and only works with custom objects (not standard HubSpot objects like contacts or companies).

tools.name: Create batch of feedback submissions
tools.description: Creates a batch of feedback submissions in HubSpot, ideal for bulk imports; all property names, `associationTypeId`s, and association `to_id`s must reference existing entities in HubSpot.

tools.name: Create batch of objects
tools.description: Creates multiple CRM objects of a specified `objectType` (e.g., contacts, companies, deals) in a single batch operation, where each object can have its own set of properties and associations.

tools.name: Create batch of properties
tools.description: Efficiently creates multiple CRM properties in a single batch for a specified HubSpot object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', custom object ID), ideal for schema setup or updates.

tools.name: Create batch of quotes
tools.description: Creates multiple HubSpot CRM quotes in a batch, ideal for bulk operations; provide meaningful quote details in `inputs` as property requirements can vary, and inspect response for individual quote statuses as partial success is possible.

tools.name: Create campaign
tools.description: Creates a new HubSpot campaign.

tools.name: Create campaigns
tools.description: Creates multiple HubSpot campaigns by calling the single campaign creation endpoint for each campaign. Note: HubSpot does not provide a native batch create endpoint for campaigns. This action creates multiple campaigns by making individual API calls for each campaign in the batch.

tools.name: Create companies
tools.description: Creates multiple new HubSpot companies in a single batch operation.

tools.name: Create company
tools.description: Creates a new HubSpot company.

tools.name: Create contact
tools.description: Creates a new HubSpot contact.

tools.name: Create contacts
tools.description: Creates multiple new HubSpot contacts in a single batch operation.

tools.name: Create CRM object with properties
tools.description: Creates a new HubSpot CRM object (e.g., contact, company, custom object) with specified `properties` (using valid internal names) and `associations` (to existing objects via valid type IDs).

tools.name: Create deal
tools.description: Creates a new HubSpot deal.

tools.name: Create deals
tools.description: Creates multiple deals in HubSpot CRM; ensure any associated object IDs, deal stages, and pipeline IDs specified are valid and exist within the HubSpot account.

tools.name: Create email
tools.description: Creates a new HubSpot email engagement record. REQUIRED FIELDS in properties dict: - hs_email_subject: Subject line - hs_email_html: HTML content - hs_timestamp: Unix timestamp in milliseconds - hs_email_direction: One of 'EMAIL', 'INCOMING_EMAIL', 'FORWARDED_EMAIL', 'DRAFT_EMAIL' This creates an email engagement/activity record in HubSpot CRM, not a marketing email.

tools.name: Create emails
tools.description: Creates multiple HubSpot emails in a single batch operation.

tools.name: Create event template for app
tools.description: Creates a new event template for a HubSpot app, defining structure, custom properties (tokens), and appearance (Markdown with Handlebars) of custom timeline events for CRM objects; this template must exist before logging corresponding events.

tools.name: Create feedback submission
tools.description: Creates a new HubSpot feedback submission to record customer feedback (e.g., survey responses, support interactions), optionally associating it with CRM objects.

tools.name: Create line item
tools.description: Creates a new HubSpot line item.

tools.name: Create line items
tools.description: Creates multiple HubSpot line items in a single batch operation.

tools.name: Create multiple timeline events batch
tools.description: Creates multiple immutable timeline events in a batch, ideal for bulk data imports or real-time synchronizations, using a valid event template; may update CRM properties if the template is so configured.

tools.name: Create new object schema with custom properties
tools.description: Creates a new custom object schema in HubSpot CRM with unique naming for schema and properties, defined display/required/searchable properties within the 'properties' list, provided immutable labels, and correctly configured 'enumeration' type properties (options/referencedObjectType).

tools.name: Create note
tools.description: Creates a new HubSpot CRM note. Use when you need to add a timestamped note with optional attachments and associations to contacts, companies, deals, or tickets.

tools.name: Create or update draft version
tools.description: Creates or updates the draft version of a marketing email identified by `emailId`; if no draft exists, a new one is created from the current live version to prepare changes or A/B tests before publishing.

tools.name: Create pipeline for object type
tools.description: Creates a new HubSpot pipeline for a specified CRM `objectType` (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets'), requiring the pipeline `label` be unique for that `objectType` and each stage `label` be unique within the pipeline.

tools.name: Create pipeline stage
tools.description: Creates a new stage in a specified HubSpot CRM pipeline for a given object type, such as 'deals' or 'tickets'.

tools.name: Create product
tools.description: Creates a new HubSpot product. Note: Products are catalog items and cannot be directly associated with deals, contacts, or companies. To connect product information to a deal or quote, create a line item using HUBSPOT_CREATE_LINE_ITEM that references this product's ID via hs_product_id.

tools.name: Create products
tools.description: Creates multiple HubSpot products in a single batch operation.

tools.name: Create property for specified object type
tools.description: Creates a new custom property for a specified HubSpot CRM object type; ensure `groupName` refers to an existing property group for the `objectType`.

tools.name: Create quote object
tools.description: Creates a new quote object in HubSpot CRM with specified properties and associations.

tools.name: Create task
tools.description: Creates a new CRM task record. Use when adding a task with properties and optional associations.

tools.name: Create ticket
tools.description: Creates a new HubSpot ticket.

tools.name: Create tickets
tools.description: Creates multiple HubSpot tickets in a batch, each with its own properties and associations; `inputs` list must not be empty, each item needs `properties`, and associations/custom properties must be validly defined using internal names for custom fields and ISO 8601 for dates.

tools.name: Create timeline event based on template
tools.description: Creates an immutable custom timeline event on a CRM object's record using a specified, existing event template (identified by `eventTemplateId`), optionally updating CRM object properties if defined in the template; requires `email`, `utk`, or `objectId` for association.

tools.name: Create workflow
tools.description: Creates a new HubSpot workflow to automate processes; ensure `enrollmentCriteria` and `actions` use properties relevant to the specified `objectTypeId`.

tools.name: Archive a batch of campaigns
tools.description: Archives a batch of up to 50 marketing campaigns, hiding them from active views rather than permanently deleting them.

tools.name: Delete a marketing email
tools.description: Permanently deletes a marketing email from your HubSpot account. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete calling extension settings
tools.description: Permanently deletes the settings for a calling extension app, specified by its `appId`, rendering it unusable for all connected HubSpot accounts; this operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete campaign
tools.description: Permanently deletes a marketing campaign from HubSpot using its `campaignGuid`; returns a 204 No Content status even if the campaign does not exist.

tools.name: Delete contact for gdpr compliance
tools.description: Irreversibly deletes a HubSpot contact for GDPR compliance (identified via `objectId` and `idProperty`); an email `objectId` for a non-existent contact may be blocklisted.

tools.name: Delete pipeline by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes a HubSpot pipeline and all its stages by `pipelineId` and `objectType`; this is irreversible, so use validation flags to avoid errors if the pipeline is not empty.

tools.name: Delete pipeline stage by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific pipeline stage for an `objectType` (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets') that supports pipelines; this operation is irreversible, so ensure no active CRM records are associated with the stage to prevent data issues.

tools.name: Delete schema by object type
tools.description: Deletes a HubSpot custom object schema by `objectType`. With `archived=false` (default), it archives the schema (soft delete). With `archived=true`, it permanently deletes an already-archived schema (hard delete). Prerequisites: All object instances, associations, and properties must be deleted first.

tools.name: Delete timeline event template
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a specific timeline event template, identified by its `eventTemplateId`, from the application `appId`.

tools.name: Delete video conferencing app settings
tools.description: Irreversibly deletes all settings for a video conferencing application identified by its `appId` in HubSpot, removing its configuration and preventing it from functioning until reconfigured; existing meetings and historical data are unaffected. Note: This API requires developer API key (hapikey) authentication from your HubSpot developer account, not OAuth tokens.

tools.name: Delete workflow
tools.description: Permanently deletes a HubSpot workflow by its ID; deleted workflows cannot be restored via the API and the ID must exist.

tools.name: Fetch import error details
tools.description: Fetches a paginated list of read-only error details for a specific HubSpot CRM import, requiring a valid `importId` for a processed import.

tools.name: Fetch recording settings by app ID
tools.description: Fetches call recording settings for a specified, existing HubSpot calling extension app.

tools.name: Fetch revenue
tools.description: Fetches a revenue attribution report for a specified, existing marketing campaign, optionally using a specific attribution model and date range; if both start and end dates are given, `endDate` must not be earlier than `startDate`.

tools.name: GDPR delete
tools.description: Permanently deletes a contact and associated content for GDPR compliance; an email used for identification via `idProperty`='email' that is not found will be irreversibly blocklisted.

tools.name: Get Account Information
tools.description: Gets current HubSpot account info (email, hubId, user details) using access-token lookup.

tools.name: Get active imports list
tools.description: Retrieves a list of currently active import jobs in HubSpot for monitoring ongoing data operations.

tools.name: Get aggregated statistic intervals
tools.description: Retrieves aggregated statistics for marketing emails (e.g., send counts), grouped by specified time intervals within a defined time range.

tools.name: Get aggregated statistics
tools.description: Retrieves aggregated statistics for marketing emails, optionally within an ISO8601 formatted time range, by email IDs, or specific email properties.

tools.name: Get all marketing emails for a HubSpot account
tools.description: Fetches a list of marketing emails from a HubSpot account, with options for filtering, sorting, pagination, and including performance statistics.

tools.name: Get all workflows
tools.description: Retrieves a list of workflow summaries (ID, name, type, status) from HubSpot, using the 'limit' parameter for pagination.

tools.name: Get a revision of a marketing email
tools.description: Retrieves a specific, previously saved revision of a marketing email using its unique email ID and revision ID.

tools.name: Get campaign
tools.description: Retrieves a HubSpot campaign by its ID.

tools.name: Get campaign metrics
tools.description: Retrieves key attribution metrics for an existing marketing campaign, identified by its `campaignGuid`, within an optional date range.

tools.name: Get campaigns
tools.description: Retrieves multiple HubSpot campaigns.

tools.name: Get company
tools.description: Retrieves a HubSpot company by its ID.

tools.name: Get contact IDs
tools.description: Fetches a list of contact IDs for a specific HubSpot campaign based on interaction type.

tools.name: Get deal
tools.description: Retrieves a HubSpot deal by its ID.

tools.name: Get deals
tools.description: Retrieves multiple HubSpot deals by their IDs in a single batch request.

tools.name: Get draft version of a marketing email
tools.description: Retrieves the draft version of a marketing email by its `emailId`; if no draft exists, returns the published version.

tools.name: Get emails
tools.description: Retrieves multiple HubSpot email engagement records by their IDs in a single batch request.

tools.name: Get import record information
tools.description: Retrieves a comprehensive summary of a specific HubSpot CRM import record by its `importId`, including status, progress, updates, results, and errors; useful for monitoring and troubleshooting data imports.

tools.name: Get Marketing Emails
tools.description: Fetches a list of marketing emails from HubSpot, supporting filtering by creation/update timestamps, pagination, and sorting.

tools.name: Get pipeline stage audit
tools.description: Retrieves a reverse chronological list of all mutations (changes) for a specific pipeline stage, including CREATE and UPDATE events with timestamps and details.

tools.name: Get product
tools.description: Retrieves a HubSpot product by its ID.

tools.name: Get products
tools.description: Retrieves multiple HubSpot products by their IDs.

tools.name: Get quote by id
tools.description: Retrieves a specific HubSpot quote by its unique identifier.

tools.name: Get revisions of a marketing email
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all historical versions (including full state like content, settings, metadata) for a specified, existing marketing email; revision ID -1 identifies the current version.

tools.name: Get segment members
tools.description: Tool to retrieve segment (list) members ordered by join timestamp. Use when you need to page through list membership data.

tools.name: Get specific event template for app
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific event template for a given application in HubSpot's CRM timeline.

tools.name: Get the details of a specified marketing email
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific marketing email in HubSpot using its unique email ID, optionally including performance statistics and specific properties.

tools.name: Get the variation of an A/B marketing email
tools.description: Retrieves the alternate variation of a specified A/B marketing email; the `emailId` must identify an email currently in an A/B test. Requires Marketing Hub Professional or Enterprise subscription.

tools.name: Get ticket
tools.description: Retrieves a HubSpot ticket by its ID.

tools.name: Get tickets
tools.description: Retrieves multiple HubSpot tickets by their IDs.

tools.name: Get workflow by ID
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for an existing HubSpot workflow by its unique ID; unsupported actions are designated 'UNSUPPORTED_ACTION' in the response.

tools.name: Get workflow email campaigns
tools.description: Retrieves email campaigns associated with a specific HubSpot workflow ID.

tools.name: Initiate data import process
tools.description: Call this action to start an asynchronous data import into HubSpot CRM using uploaded files and a detailed `importRequest` JSON configuration, ensuring this JSON correctly maps file columns to HubSpot properties and files align with these mappings.

tools.name: List Emails
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of HubSpot emails, allowing selection of specific properties (with or without history), associated object IDs, and filtering by archive status.

tools.name: List all event templates for app
tools.description: Retrieves all event templates associated with a valid `appId` for an existing application in HubSpot's CRM Timeline.

tools.name: List assets
tools.description: Lists assets of a specific `assetType` for a given HubSpot marketing `campaignGuid`, optionally including performance metrics for a date range.

tools.name: List association types
tools.description: Lists all valid association types between two specified HubSpot CRM object types.

tools.name: List companies
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of HubSpot companies.

tools.name: List contact properties
tools.description: Lists all contact properties in your HubSpot account, including custom properties you've created. Use this action to discover: - Available property names for updating contacts - Custom properties specific to your HubSpot account - Property types and valid options for enumeration fields - Which properties are read-only vs writable

tools.name: List contacts
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of HubSpot contacts.

tools.name: List deals
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of HubSpot deals.

tools.name: List feedback submissions page
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of feedback submissions from HubSpot, allowing specification of properties (including history), associated object IDs, and filtering by archive status.

tools.name: List granted OAuth scopes
tools.description: Tool to introspect the current OAuth access token and return its granted scopes and metadata. Use when you need to check which permissions are available before calling an endpoint (e.g., workflows, automation) to proactively detect missing scopes and provide clear remediation guidance.

tools.name: List products
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of HubSpot products.

tools.name: List quotes page
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of quotes, allowing selection of specific properties, property history, associated object IDs, and filtering by archived status.

tools.name: List tickets
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of HubSpot tickets.

tools.name: Merge contacts
tools.description: Merges two HubSpot contacts into one.

tools.name: Merge deals
tools.description: Merges two HubSpot deals into one.

tools.name: Merge emails
tools.description: Merges two HubSpot emails into one.

tools.name: Merge products
tools.description: Merges two HubSpot products into one.

tools.name: Merge tickets
tools.description: Merges two HubSpot tickets into one.

tools.name: Merge two companies of same type
tools.description: Merges two existing company records of the same type in HubSpot CRM, where `objectIdToMerge` is absorbed into `primaryObjectId`; this operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Merge two feedback submissions
tools.description: Merges two existing feedback submissions by ID, primarily for consolidating duplicates or related feedback; this operation is irreversible, and `primaryObjectId` values take precedence in conflicts.

tools.name: Merge two line items of same type
tools.description: Merges two line items, `objectIdToMerge` into `primaryObjectId`, which must be of the same type; `objectIdToMerge` is absorbed and the operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Merge two objects of same type
tools.description: Merges two distinct HubSpot CRM objects of the same `objectType`, consolidating data into `primaryObjectId` (which is preserved) and deleting `objectIdToMerge`; this operation is permanent and irreversible.

tools.name: Merge two quotes of same type
tools.description: Merges two distinct quotes of the same type by consolidating `objectIdToMerge` into `primaryObjectId` (e.g., for combining information or updating terms); this operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Modify calling extension settings
tools.description: Updates settings (e.g., display name, UI URL/dimensions, feature flags) for an existing calling extension app, identified by `appId`.

tools.name: Partially update CRM object by ID
tools.description: Partially updates specified properties of a CRM object (e.g., contact, company, deal) identified by its type and ID, or optionally by a unique property value if `idProperty` is specified.

tools.name: Partially update pipeline by id
tools.description: Partially updates a CRM pipeline's label, display order, or restores an archived pipeline by setting `archived` to `false`.

tools.name: Partially update property group
tools.description: Partially updates a property group's `displayOrder` or `label` for a specified CRM `objectType` in HubSpot.

tools.name: Partial update quote by quote id
tools.description: Performs a partial update on an existing HubSpot quote's specified properties, identifying the quote by `quoteId` (either its internal ID or a custom unique property value if `idProperty` is provided).

tools.name: Permanently delete company for GDPR compliance
tools.description: Permanently deletes a company (identified by objectId) and its associated data from HubSpot for GDPR compliance; this action is irreversible and requires the company to exist.

tools.name: Permanently delete contact for GDPR
tools.description: Irreversibly deletes a HubSpot contact for GDPR; if deleting by a non-existent email (using idProperty 'email'), the email is blocklisted instead.

tools.name: Permanently delete contact for GDPR compliance
tools.description: Irreversibly erases a HubSpot contact and associated data per a GDPR request; if an email is given for a non-existent contact, it's blocklisted.

tools.name: Permanently delete contact for GDPR compliance
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a HubSpot contact and all associated data to comply with GDPR's 'right to be forgotten'. If deleting by email and the contact doesn't exist, the email is blocklisted.

tools.name: Permanently delete contact via GDPR
tools.description: Permanently deletes a HubSpot contact and all its associated data for GDPR compliance, identifying the contact by its ID or another unique property.

tools.name: Archive deal (GDPR permanent delete not supported for deals)
tools.description: Archives a HubSpot deal by its ID. Note: HubSpot's GDPR permanent deletion API only supports contacts, not deals. This action archives the deal (moves to recycling bin for 90 days) as the closest available functionality.

tools.name: Permanently delete GDPR contact and content
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes an existing HubSpot contact and associated content for GDPR compliance, optionally blocklisting the contact's email.

tools.name: Permanently delete line items for gdpr
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specified line item and its associated content for GDPR compliance; this action is irreversible and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Publish or send a marketing email
tools.description: Publishes or sends a specified HubSpot marketing email that is valid and ready for sending; requires Marketing Hub Enterprise or the transactional email add-on.

tools.name: Purge schema by object type
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes the schema for an existing `objectType` in HubSpot CRM; this deprecated endpoint should be used with extreme caution.

tools.name: Read Email
tools.description: Call this to retrieve an existing HubSpot email by its `emailId` or an alternative unique `idProperty`.

tools.name: Read a batch of CRM object properties
tools.description: Retrieves property definitions (metadata) for a batch of CRM object properties for a specified object type. Returns detailed information about property structure, data types, options, and configuration—not the actual property values of CRM records.

tools.name: Read a CRM property by name
tools.description: Reads a specific CRM property definition for a given HubSpot object type by its internal name.

tools.name: Read all properties for object type
tools.description: Retrieves definitions and metadata (not actual values) for properties of a specified HubSpot CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', or custom objects).

tools.name: Read a page of objects by type
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of objects for a specified and valid HubSpot CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', or custom ID).

tools.name: Read a property group
tools.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific property group of a given CRM object type, detailing its structure and attributes, but not the actual property values of CRM objects.

tools.name: Read batch feedback submissions by id or property
tools.description: Retrieves up to 100 feedback submissions in a batch using their IDs or a specified unique `idProperty`, optionally including specified properties and their history.

tools.name: Read batch of crm objects by id or property values
tools.description: Reads a batch of CRM objects of a specified `objectType` using their HubSpot IDs or unique property values from the `inputs` list, allowing retrieval of specific `properties`, their historical values (`propertiesWithHistory`), and filtering by `archived` status.

tools.name: Read batch of line items by id or property values
tools.description: Retrieves a batch of HubSpot CRM line items by their IDs, or optionally by values of a custom unique property defined in `idProperty`.

tools.name: Read batch of quotes by property values
tools.description: Efficiently retrieves a batch of HubSpot CRM quotes by their IDs (or a specified unique property), optionally including archived quotes, specific properties, and property history.

tools.name: Read budget
tools.description: Fetches detailed budget (total, spent, remaining) and spend information for a marketing campaign, including an 'order' field for sequencing budget/spend items (0 is oldest).

tools.name: Read contact
tools.description: Retrieves a HubSpot contact by its ID.

tools.name: Read contacts
tools.description: Batch read multiple HubSpot contacts by their IDs or custom identifier property. This action retrieves up to 100 contacts per request using the HubSpot CRM batch read API. You can specify which contact properties to return and optionally include historical values for properties.

tools.name: Read crm object by id
tools.description: Retrieves a specific CRM object (e.g., contact, company, deal, ticket) by its ID or a unique property, optionally including specific properties, history, and associations.

tools.name: Read feedback submission by id
tools.description: Reads a HubSpot feedback submission by its ID, optionally using a custom unique 'idProperty', and allows specifying properties to return including history and associations.

tools.name: Read property groups for object type
tools.description: Retrieves all property groups in a single call for a specified HubSpot CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies'), returning only the groups themselves, not the individual properties within them.

tools.name: Remove asset association
tools.description: Disassociates an asset from a HubSpot marketing campaign. Supports a wide range of asset types including forms, landing pages, emails, blog posts, workflows, static lists, and more.

tools.name: Remove association from schema
tools.description: Permanently removes a specified association definition (type) from a HubSpot object's schema, preventing future creations of this association type without affecting existing instances.

tools.name: Remove deal
tools.description: Removes a HubSpot deal by its ID.

tools.name: Remove token from event template
tools.description: Removes a token from a HubSpot event template, preventing its inclusion in new events created from that template.

tools.name: Render event detail template
tools.description: Renders detailed information for a specific HubSpot CRM timeline event using a predefined event template, ignoring `extraData` references in the template not present in event data.

tools.name: Render event header or detail as html
tools.description: Renders an event's header or detail template as HTML for a specified event on the HubSpot CRM timeline, using a given event template ID and event ID.

tools.name: Replace all properties of pipeline
tools.description: Overwrites an entire CRM pipeline (specified by `objectType` and `pipelineId`) and all its stages with a new definition, returning the updated pipeline.

tools.name: Replace pipeline stage properties
tools.description: Replaces all properties of a specified pipeline stage; the new `label` must be unique within the pipeline, and if `objectType` is 'deals', the `metadata` must include a 'probability' key.

tools.name: Reset draft
tools.description: Resets a marketing email's draft to its currently published (live) version, discarding all unpublished changes; the email must have a live version to revert to.

tools.name: Restore a revision of a marketing email
tools.description: Restores a specific, existing, non-active revision of a marketing email to become the new live version for that email.

tools.name: Restore a revision of a marketing email to draft state
tools.description: Restores a specific revision of a marketing email to a DRAFT state, overwriting any existing draft.

tools.name: Retrieve all object schemas
tools.description: Retrieves all object schema definitions (not data records) for a HubSpot account, supporting retrieval of either active or archived schemas.

tools.name: Retrieve all pipelines for specified object type
tools.description: Retrieves all pipelines in HubSpot for a specified CRM object type, such as deals or tickets.

tools.name: Retrieve calling settings for app
tools.description: Retrieves the read-only calling extension settings for a specific HubSpot app; the app must exist and have calling extensions configured.

tools.name: Retrieve existing object schema
tools.description: Fetches the detailed schema definition for a specified, existing standard or custom HubSpot CRM object type; this action is read-only and does not create or modify schemas.

tools.name: Retrieve line item by id
tools.description: Retrieves a HubSpot CRM line item by its ID or a specified unique property (`idProperty`).

tools.name: Retrieve line items list
tools.description: Fetches a paginated list of HubSpot CRM line items, allowing selection of specific properties (including history), associated object IDs, and filtering by archive status; ensure property and association names are valid HubSpot internal names.

tools.name: Retrieve owner by ID or user ID
tools.description: Retrieves a specific HubSpot CRM owner by their ID, with options to specify ID type (owner or user) and to include archived records.

tools.name: Retrieve owners
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all owners in the HubSpot CRM, including their ID, first name, last name, email, and user ID.

tools.name: Retrieve page of crm owners
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of CRM owners from HubSpot, optionally filtering by email or archived status.

tools.name: Retrieve pipeline stage by id
tools.description: Fetches detailed properties and metadata (e.g., label, display order, custom properties) for a specific stage within a HubSpot CRM pipeline, identified by its `objectType`, `pipelineId`, and `stageId`.

tools.name: Retrieve pipeline stages
tools.description: Fetches all stages for a specified HubSpot CRM object type and pipeline ID.

tools.name: Retrieve timeline event by ids
tools.description: Retrieves a specific HubSpot CRM timeline event by its application ID, event template ID, and event ID, returning event details including timestamp, tokens, and associated object information.

tools.name: Retrieve video conference settings by id
tools.description: Retrieves video conference application settings, such as webhook URLs and user/account management configurations, for a specified `appId`.

tools.name: Return pipeline by id
tools.description: Retrieves a specific pipeline by its ID and CRM object type, detailing its stages and properties.

tools.description: Searches HubSpot CRM objects (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies') by `objectType` using complex criteria including filters, sorting, and pagination; property names used in filters, sorts, and returned properties must be valid for the specified `objectType`.

tools.name: Search emails

tools.name: Search feedback submissions
tools.description: Searches for feedback submissions in HubSpot CRM using text query, filter groups, sorting, and pagination, returning specified properties.

tools.name: Search products

tools.name: Search quotes by criteria
tools.description: Searches HubSpot CRM quotes using a text query, complex filter criteria, sorting, and pagination.

tools.name: Search tickets
tools.description: Searches for HubSpot tickets using flexible criteria and filters.

tools.name: Update Email
tools.description: Partially updates properties of an existing HubSpot email object, identified by `emailId` (as internal ID or custom unique property value if `idProperty` is given); the object must exist.

tools.name: Update a batch of campaigns

tools.name: Update a marketing email

tools.name: Update batch feedback submissions
tools.description: Updates a batch of HubSpot feedback submissions; property keys must be existing internal HubSpot names and values must be correctly formatted strings.

tools.name: Update a batch of objects by id or property values

name: Linear
description: Linear is a streamlined issue tracking and project planning tool for modern teams, featuring fast workflows, keyboard shortcuts, and GitHub integrations

tools.name: Add reaction to comment
tools.description: Tool to add a reaction to an existing Linear comment. Use when you want to programmatically react to a comment on an issue.

tools.name: Create linear attachment
tools.description: Creates a new attachment and associates it with a specific, existing Linear issue.

tools.name: Create a comment
tools.description: Creates a new comment on a specified Linear issue.

tools.name: Create linear issue
tools.description: Creates a new issue in a specified Linear project and team, requiring team_id and title, and allowing for optional properties like description, assignee, state, priority, cycle, and due date.

tools.name: Get create issue default params
tools.description: Fetches a Linear team's default issue estimate and state, useful for pre-filling new issue forms.

tools.name: Create issue relation
tools.description: Create a relationship between two Linear issues using the issueRelationCreate mutation. Use this to establish connections like 'blocks', 'duplicate', or 'related' between issues.

tools.name: Create a label
tools.description: Creates a new label in Linear for a specified team, used to categorize and organize issues. Label names must be unique within each team. If a label with the same name already exists, the existing label will be returned.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Creates a new Linear project with specified name and team associations.

tools.name: Delete issue
tools.description: Archives an existing Linear issue by its ID, which is Linear's standard way of deleting issues; the operation is idempotent.

tools.name: Get all teams
tools.description: Retrieves all teams from the Linear workspace without requiring any parameters.

tools.name: Download issue attachments
tools.description: Downloads a specific attachment from a Linear issue; the `file_name` must include the correct file extension.

tools.name: Get current user
tools.description: Gets the currently authenticated user's ID, name, email, and other profile information. Use this to identify 'me' in other Linear operations that require user ID filtering.

tools.name: Get cycles by team ID
tools.description: Retrieves all cycles for a specified Linear team ID; cycles are time-boxed work periods (like sprints) and the team ID must correspond to an existing team.

tools.name: Get Linear issue
tools.description: Retrieves an existing Linear issue's comprehensive details, including id, identifier, title, description, timestamps, state, team, creator, attachments, comments (with user info and timestamps), subscribers, and due date.

tools.name: Get Linear project
tools.description: Retrieves a single Linear project by its unique identifier. Use when verifying a newly created or updated project, or when fetching detailed project information by ID.

tools.name: List issue drafts
tools.description: Tool to list issue drafts. Use when you need to fetch draft issues for review or further editing.

tools.name: List issues by team ID
tools.description: Tool to list all issues for a specific Linear team, scoped by team ID. Use when you need to retrieve issues belonging to a particular team without fetching workspace-wide issues. This is more efficient than workspace-wide listing followed by client-side filtering.

tools.name: Get all cycles
tools.description: Retrieves all cycles (time-boxed iterations for work) from the Linear account; no filters are applied.

tools.name: List Linear issues
tools.description: Lists non-archived Linear issues; if project_id is not specified, issues from all accessible projects are returned. Can also filter by assignee_id to get issues assigned to a specific user.

tools.name: Get labels
tools.description: Retrieves labels from Linear. If team_id is provided, returns labels for that specific team. If team_id is omitted, returns all labels across the workspace.

tools.name: List linear projects
tools.description: Retrieves all projects from the Linear account.

tools.name: List Linear states
tools.description: Retrieves all workflow states for a specified team in Linear, representing the stages an issue progresses through in that team's workflow.

tools.name: Get teams
tools.description: Retrieves all teams with their members. Optionally filters each team's associated projects by project_id.

tools.name: List Linear users
tools.description: Lists all users in the Linear workspace with their IDs, names, emails, and active status.

tools.name: Manage draft
tools.description: Tool to create, update, or delete issue drafts in Linear. Use when you need to save or modify draft notes before converting to an issue. Note: Linear's public GraphQL API does not expose explicit Issue Draft mutations. This action leverages standard Issue mutations to emulate draft management: - create -> issueCreate - update -> issueUpdate - delete -> issueDelete The response maps the created/updated Issue fields to the DraftModel for compatibility.

tools.name: Remove label from Linear issue
tools.description: Removes a specified label from an existing Linear issue using their IDs; successful even if the label isn't on the issue.

tools.name: Remove reaction from comment
tools.description: Tool to remove a reaction on a comment. Use when you have a reaction ID and need to delete it.

tools.name: Run Query or Mutation
tools.description: Execute any GraphQL query or mutation against Linear's API. USE WHEN: No dedicated action exists, need complex filtering, custom fields, or schema discovery. *** INTROSPECTION FIRST - NEVER GUESS FIELD NAMES *** Run introspection before unknown operations: - query { __type(name: "Issue") { fields { name } } } - query { __type(name: "Mutation") { fields { name } } } Linear uses nested objects (project { id }), NOT scalar IDs (projectId). KEY: All IDs are UUIDs. Filter: { field: { eq: value } }. Pagination: nodes[] + pageInfo.

tools.name: Search Linear issues
tools.description: Search Linear issues using full-text search across identifier, title, and description. Use when you need to find issues by keywords or specific identifiers. Note: This endpoint only supports full-text search; for structured filtering by team, project, assignee, state, or labels, use LIST_ISSUES_BY_TEAM_ID instead.

tools.name: Update issue
tools.description: Updates an existing Linear issue using its `issue_id`; requires at least one other attribute for modification, and all provided entity IDs (for state, assignee, labels, etc.) must be valid.

tools.name: Update a comment
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Linear comment's body text. Use when you need to edit or modify the content of a previously created comment.

tools.name: Update Project
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Linear project. Use when you need to modify project properties like name, description, state, dates, or lead. All fields except project_id are optional - only provide the fields you want to update.

triggers.description: Triggered when a comment is received.

triggers.name: Issue Created Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a new issue is created.

triggers.name: Issue Updated Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when an issue is updated. For example labels are changed, issue status is changed, etc.

tools.name: Create Field
tools.description: Creates a new field within a specified table in an Airtable base.

tools.name: Create multiple records

tools.name: Create a record
tools.description: Creates a new record in a specified Airtable table; field values must conform to the table's column types.

tools.name: Create records

tools.name: Create table
tools.description: Creates a new table within a specified existing Airtable base, allowing definition of its name, description, and field structure.

tools.name: Delete Comment
tools.description: Tool to delete a comment from a record in an Airtable table. Use when you need to remove an existing comment. Non-admin users can only delete their own comments; Enterprise Admins can delete any comment.

tools.name: Delete multiple records
tools.description: Tool to delete up to 10 specified records from a table within an Airtable base. Use when you need to remove multiple records in a single operation.

tools.name: Delete Record
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific record from an existing table within an existing Airtable base.

tools.name: Get Base Schema
tools.description: Retrieves the detailed schema for a specified Airtable base, including its tables, fields, field types, and configurations, using the `baseId`.

tools.name: Get Record
tools.description: Retrieves a specific record from an Airtable table. Use when you need to fetch details of a single record by its ID. Empty field values are not returned in the response.

tools.name: Get user information

tools.name: List bases
tools.description: Retrieves all Airtable bases accessible to the authenticated user, which may include an 'offset' for pagination.

tools.name: List Comments
tools.description: Tool to list comments on a specific Airtable record. Use when retrieving comments for a record, with optional pagination support for large comment threads.

tools.name: List records
tools.description: Tool to list records from an Airtable table with filtering, sorting, and pagination. Use when you need to retrieve multiple records from a table with optional query parameters.

tools.name: Update Comment
tools.description: Tool to update an existing comment on a specific Airtable record. Use when modifying comment text or updating user mentions using @[userId] syntax. API users can only update comments they have created.

tools.name: Update Field
tools.description: Updates a field's name or description in an Airtable table. Use this action to modify field metadata without changing the field's type or options. At least one of 'name' or 'description' must be provided.

tools.name: Update multiple records
tools.description: Tool to update up to 10 records in an Airtable table with selective field modifications. Use when you need to modify multiple existing records or perform upsert operations. Updates are not performed atomically.

tools.name: Update multiple records (PUT)
tools.description: Tool to destructively update multiple records in Airtable using PUT, clearing unspecified fields. Use when you need to fully replace record data or perform upsert operations. Supports up to 10 records per request.

tools.name: Update record
tools.description: Modifies specified fields of an existing record in an Airtable base and table; the base, table, and record must exist.

tools.name: Update record (PUT)
tools.description: Updates an existing record in an Airtable base using PUT method. Use when you want to replace all field values, clearing any unspecified fields. For partial updates that preserve unspecified fields, use the PATCH-based update action instead.

tools.name: Update Table
tools.description: Updates the name, description, and/or date dependency settings of a table in Airtable. Use this action to modify table metadata without changing the table's fields or views. At least one of 'name', 'description', or 'dateDependencySettings' must be provided.

tools.name: Upload attachment
tools.description: Uploads a file attachment to a specified field in an Airtable record. Use when you need to add a file to an attachment field. The file must be provided as a base64-encoded string.

tools.name: Upload attachment to field
tools.description: Uploads an attachment file to a record's attachment field. Use when you need to add a file to an attachment field using the field ID. The file must be provided as a base64-encoded string. Supports files up to 5GB. This endpoint uses the corrected format without tableIdOrName parameter.

tools.name: Get Transitions

tools.name: Get Issue Votes

name: Firecrawl
description: Firecrawl automates web crawling and data extraction, enabling organizations to gather content, index sites, and gain insights from online sources at scale

tools.name: Batch scrape multiple URLs
tools.description: Tool to scrape multiple URLs in batch with concurrent processing. Use when you need to scrape multiple web pages efficiently with customizable formats and content filtering.

tools.name: Cancel a batch scrape job
tools.description: Tool to cancel a running batch scrape job using its unique identifier. Use when you need to terminate an in-progress batch scrape operation.

tools.name: Get batch scrape status
tools.description: Retrieves the current status and results of a batch scrape job using the job ID. Use this to check batch scrape progress and retrieve scraped data.

tools.name: Get errors from batch scrape job
tools.description: Tool to retrieve error details from a batch scrape job, including failed URLs and URLs blocked by robots.txt. Use when you need to debug or understand why certain pages failed to scrape in a batch operation.

tools.name: Cancel a crawl job
tools.description: Cancels an active or queued web crawl job using its ID; attempting to cancel completed, failed, or previously canceled jobs will not change their state.

tools.name: Start a web crawl
tools.description: Initiates a Firecrawl web crawl from a given URL, applying various filtering and content extraction rules, and polls until the job is complete; ensure the URL is accessible and any regex patterns for paths are valid.

tools.name: Get all active crawl jobs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all active crawl jobs for the authenticated team. Use when you need to see which crawl operations are currently running.

tools.name: Cancel a crawl job
tools.description: Tool to cancel a running crawl job by its ID. Use when you need to stop an active crawl operation. The API returns a status of 'cancelled' upon successful cancellation.

tools.name: Get crawl job status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the status and results of a Firecrawl crawl job. Use when you need to check the progress or get data from an ongoing or completed crawl operation. Returns crawl status, progress metrics, credits used, and the crawled page data.

tools.name: Get errors from a crawl job
tools.description: Tool to retrieve errors from a Firecrawl crawl job. Use when you need to understand why certain pages failed to scrape or which URLs were blocked by robots.txt during a crawl operation.

tools.name: Preview crawl parameters
tools.description: Preview crawl parameters before starting a crawl by generating optimal configuration from natural language instructions. Use this tool to understand what crawl settings will be applied based on your requirements before executing a full crawl operation. The endpoint intelligently interprets natural language prompts to configure crawl parameters like include/exclude paths, depth limits, and domain scope.

tools.name: Start a web crawl (v2) [NEW]
tools.description: [NEW v2 API] Initiates a Firecrawl v2 web crawl with enhanced features over v1: natural language prompts for automatic crawler configuration, crawlEntireDomain for sibling/parent page discovery, better depth control with maxDiscoveryDepth, subdomain support, and full webhook configuration. Polls until crawl is complete.

tools.name: Get team credit usage
tools.description: Tool to get current team credit usage information. Use when you need to check remaining credits or billing period details.

tools.name: Get historical team credit usage
tools.description: Tool to retrieve historical team credit usage on a monthly basis. Use when you need to analyze credit consumption patterns over time, optionally segmented by API key.

tools.name: Perform deep research
tools.description: Initiates an AI-powered deep research operation that autonomously explores the web to investigate any topic and synthesizes findings from multiple sources. The research process iteratively searches, analyzes, and synthesizes information across multiple web sources, providing comprehensive insights with source citations. Results include a final analysis, detailed activity timeline, and curated source list. Billing: 1 credit per URL analyzed. Control costs with the maxUrls parameter. Note: This API is in Alpha and being deprecated in favor of the Search API after June 30, 2025.

tools.name: Extract structured data
tools.description: Extracts structured data from web pages by initiating an extraction job and polling for completion; requires a natural language `prompt` or a JSON `schema` (one must be provided).

tools.name: Get extract job status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the status and results of a previously submitted extract job. Use when you need to check the progress or get the final results of an extraction operation.

tools.name: Generate LLMs.txt for a website
tools.description: Initiates an async job to generate an LLMs.txt file for a website, converting web content into LLM-friendly format. Returns a job ID to check status and retrieve results. Use when you need to create a standardized, machine-readable representation of website content for language models.

tools.name: Get deep research status
tools.description: Retrieves the status and results of a deep research job by its ID. Use when you need to check the progress or retrieve the final analysis of a deep research operation.

tools.name: Get LLMs.txt generation job status
tools.description: Tool to get the status and results of an LLMs.txt generation job. Use when you need to check if a job has completed and retrieve the generated content.

tools.name: Get the status of a crawl job
tools.description: Retrieves the current status, progress, and details of a web crawl job, using the job ID obtained when the crawl was initiated.

tools.name: Map multiple URLs
tools.description: Maps a website by discovering URLs from a starting base URL, with options to customize the crawl via search query, subdomain inclusion, sitemap handling, and result limits; search effectiveness is site-dependent.

tools.name: Get team queue status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve metrics about the team's scrape queue. Use when you need to check queue status, job counts, or concurrency limits.

tools.name: Scrape URL
tools.description: Scrapes a publicly accessible URL, optionally performing pre-scrape browser actions or extracting structured JSON using an LLM, to retrieve content in specified formats.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Performs a web search for a query, scrapes content from the top search results using Firecrawl, and returns details in specified formats.

tools.name: Get team token usage
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current team's token usage and balance information for Firecrawl's Extract feature. Use when you need to check remaining token credits, plan allocation, or billing period details.

tools.name: Get historical team token usage
tools.description: Tool to retrieve historical team token usage on a monthly basis. Use when you need to analyze token consumption patterns over time, optionally segmented by API key.

required.description: The base url for your firecrawl api

required.description: Your FireCrawl API key for authentication. Obtain it from your FireCrawl settings.

name: Tavily
description: Tavily offers search and data retrieval solutions, helping teams quickly locate and filter relevant information from documents, databases, or web sources

tools.name: Tavily crawl
tools.description: Tool to perform intelligent graph-based website crawling with parallel path exploration and content extraction. Use when you need to traverse and extract content from multiple pages of a website following specific patterns or instructions. Supports depth/breadth controls, domain filtering, and natural language instructions for guided crawling.

tools.name: Tavily extract
tools.description: Tool to extract and parse web page content from specified URLs using Tavily's extract endpoint. Use when you need to retrieve clean, structured content from web pages with optional image extraction and content reranking based on query relevance.

tools.name: Tavily map website
tools.description: Tool to map a website and discover its pages. Use when you need to scan a website and get a structured list of URLs/pages it contains without extracting full content.

tools.name: Tavily search
tools.description: Use this to perform a web search via the Tavily API; offers controls for search depth, content types, result count, and domain filtering.

name: YouTube
description: YouTube is a video-sharing platform with user-generated content, live streaming, and monetization opportunities, widely used for marketing, education, and entertainment

tools.name: Add Video to Playlist
tools.description: Tool to add a video to a playlist by inserting a playlist item. Use when organizing videos into playlists or building curated collections.

tools.name: Create Playlist
tools.description: Tool to create a new YouTube playlist on the authenticated user's channel. Use when organizing videos into collections or building curated playlists.

tools.name: Delete Video
tools.description: Tool to delete a YouTube video owned by the authenticated user/channel. Use when you need to permanently remove a video from YouTube. Requires explicit confirmation via `confirmDelete: true` to prevent accidental deletions. The video must exist and be owned by the authenticated channel.

tools.name: Get Channel Activities
tools.description: Gets recent activities from a YouTube channel including video uploads, playlist additions, likes, and other channel events.

tools.name: Get channel ID by handle
tools.description: Retrieves the YouTube Channel ID for a specific YouTube channel handle.

tools.name: Get Channel Statistics
tools.description: Gets detailed statistics for YouTube channels including subscriber counts, view counts, and video counts. Channels can be identified using their ID, handle (e.g., @Google), or username.

tools.name: Video Details Batch
tools.description: Retrieves multiple YouTube video resource parts in a single batch call. Use when you need cohort-level metrics for many videos to reduce quota usage and latency.

tools.name: List captions
tools.description: Retrieves a list of caption tracks for a YouTube video. Returns an empty items list if no captions are available. Raises ExecutionFailed if the video ID is invalid or not found.

tools.name: List channel videos
tools.description: Lists videos from a specified YouTube channel. This action primarily uses the playlistItems.list endpoint with the channel's uploads playlist, which is the recommended approach by YouTube. The uploads playlist ID is obtained by fetching the channel resource via the Channels API and extracting the playlist ID from contentDetails.relatedPlaylists.uploads field. If the uploads playlist returns a 404 error (which can happen due to a known YouTube API bug where the returned playlist ID doesn't actually exist), the action automatically falls back to the search.list endpoint to retrieve channel videos. Note that the search fallback has higher quota cost (100 units vs 1 unit) and is limited to 500 results. If a channel exists but has no uploads playlist (e.g., brand accounts, channels with all videos deleted, or channels that haven't uploaded any public content), an empty result set is returned instead of an error.

tools.name: List Comment Threads
tools.description: List comment threads from YouTube videos or channels for qualitative analysis and reporting. Returns top-level comments with optional replies (up to 5 per thread). Use the 'videoId' parameter to retrieve comments on a specific video (most common use case).

tools.name: List Most Popular Videos
tools.description: Tool to list the current most-popular (charts/trending) YouTube videos for a region and/or category via videos.list(chart=mostPopular). Use when you need to retrieve YouTube's official trending or most popular videos, not keyword-search approximations.

tools.name: List Playlist Items
tools.description: Tool to list videos in a playlist, with pagination support. Use when walking through a channel's uploads playlist to enumerate all videos.

tools.name: List user playlists
tools.description: Retrieves playlists owned by the authenticated user, implicitly using mine=True.

tools.name: List user subscriptions
tools.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's YouTube channel subscriptions, allowing specification of response parts and pagination.

tools.name: Download YouTube caption track
tools.description: Downloads a specific YouTube caption track, which must be owned by the authenticated user, and returns its content as text. Note: This action requires you to own the video (YouTube Data API v3 restriction). Non-owned videos will return 403 Forbidden errors, including many auto-generated caption tracks.

tools.name: Multipart upload video
tools.description: Uploads a video to YouTube using multipart upload in a single request. Use when you want to upload both metadata and video file together. This action uploads the video file and metadata in one request, unlike resumable upload which requires two steps.

tools.name: Post Comment on Video
tools.description: Tool to post a new top-level comment on a YouTube video. Use when creating comments to engage with video content or respond to user requests.

tools.name: Search YouTube
tools.description: Searches YouTube for videos, channels, or playlists using a query term, returning the raw API response.

tools.name: Subscribe to channel
tools.description: Subscribes the authenticated user to a specified YouTube channel, identified by its unique `channelId` which must be valid and existing.

tools.name: Unsubscribe from channel
tools.description: Tool to unsubscribe the authenticated user from a YouTube channel by deleting a subscription. Use when you need to remove an existing subscription. The subscription ID can be obtained from the `YOUTUBE_LIST_USER_SUBSCRIPTIONS` tool.

tools.name: Update thumbnail
tools.description: Sets the custom thumbnail for a YouTube video using an image from a URL. Requirements: - The authenticated user must own the video or have permission to edit it - The YouTube channel must be verified (phone verification required) to upload custom thumbnails - Image must be JPG, PNG, or GIF; under 2MB; recommended 1280x720 resolution (16:9 aspect ratio)

tools.name: Update video
tools.description: Updates metadata for a YouTube video identified by videoId, which must exist; an empty list for tags removes all existing tags.

tools.name: Upload video
tools.description: Uploads a video from a local file path to a YouTube channel; the video file must be in a YouTube-supported format.

tools.name: Video details
tools.description: Retrieves specified information parts (e.g., snippet, contentDetails, statistics) for a YouTube video, identified by its ID.

triggers.name: New YouTube Activity
triggers.description: Triggers when a new activity is detected on a YouTube channel.

triggers.name: New Item in YouTube Playlist
triggers.description: Triggers when a new item is added to a YouTube playlist.

triggers.name: New Playlist in YouTube Channel
triggers.description: Triggers when a new playlist is added to a YouTube channel.

triggers.name: New YouTube Channel Subscription
triggers.description: Triggers when a new channel is subscribed.
