tools.description: Transfers ownership of multiple records to a new owner in a single operation using Salesforce's composite API for better performance.

tools.name: Parameterized Search
tools.description: Tool to execute RESTful search using parameters instead of SOSL clause. Use when you need to search across Salesforce objects with simple GET requests (URL parameters) or complex POST requests (JSON body with advanced filtering). POST method supports DataCategories, networks, orderBy constraints, and per-object filtering.

tools.name: Parameterized search POST
tools.description: Execute a SOSL search with parameters in request body for flexible querying. Use when you need complex search with multiple object types, field filtering, or advanced control.

tools.name: Upsert records using external ID
tools.description: Tool to upsert up to 200 records using external ID field matching. Use when you need to create or update multiple records efficiently in a single API call based on an external ID field.

tools.name: Update Salesforce record fields
tools.description: Tool to update specific fields in any Salesforce record (sObject) without affecting other fields. Use when you need to perform partial updates on records of any object type including standard objects (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Case) or custom objects.

tools.name: Update record via UI API
tools.description: Tool to update specific fields in an existing Salesforce record via UI API. Use when you need to modify field values on a record while preserving unchanged fields.

tools.name: Execute Composite Graph
tools.description: Tool to execute multiple related REST API requests in a single transactional call with up to 500 subrequests per graph. Use when you need to perform multiple Salesforce operations atomically where all operations must succeed or fail together. Supports referencing output from one request as input to subsequent requests using @{referenceId.fieldName} syntax.

tools.name: Create records using sObject Collections
tools.description: Tool to create up to 200 records in one request using sObject Collections. Use when you need to create multiple records of potentially different sObject types efficiently in a single API call.

tools.name: Get multiple records by IDs
tools.description: Retrieves multiple records of the same object type by IDs with a request body. Use when you need to retrieve more records than URL length limits allow (up to 2000 records vs ~800 via GET).

tools.name: Create sObject tree records
tools.description: Tool to create one or more sObject trees with root records of the specified type. Use when creating multiple related records in a single API call (e.g., an Account with multiple Contacts and Opportunities). Supports up to 200 total records across trees with maximum depth of 5 levels. All operations are atomic - if any record fails, no records are created.

tools.name: Parameterized Search
tools.description: Tool to execute parameterized search across Salesforce objects with advanced filtering. Use when you need to search for records using specific search terms with fine-grained control over which objects to search, which fields to return, and additional filtering criteria.

tools.name: Execute sObject Quick Action
tools.description: Tool to execute a specific quick action on an sObject to create records with pre-configured defaults. Use when you need to leverage Salesforce Quick Actions to streamline record creation with field mappings and default values.

tools.name: Create or update record by external ID
tools.description: Tool to create or update a single record using external ID field matching. Use when you need to upsert a record based on an external ID field value.

tools.name: Get lookup field suggestions with POST
tools.description: Tool to get lookup field suggestions with POST request. Use when editing lookup fields with dependent lookup filtering or when you need to pass source record context in the request body.

tools.name: Get lookup field suggestions with POST
tools.description: Tool to get lookup field suggestions with POST request. Use when editing lookup fields with dependent lookup filtering or when you need to pass source record context in the request body.

tools.name: Create record via UI API
tools.description: Tool to create a new record in Salesforce using the UI API. Use when you need to create records with field-level security and sharing rules enforced, with formatted and localized field values returned.

tools.name: Get related list records with request body
tools.description: Tool to retrieve related list records with request body parameters for filtering and pagination. Use when you need to get records from a related list associated with a parent record with complex query parameters. Returns up to 1,999 records per related list with pagination support.

tools.name: Execute SOQL Query
tools.description: Tool to execute SOQL queries against Salesforce. Use when you need to retrieve data from Salesforce objects using SOQL syntax. Returns up to 2000 records per request with pagination support via nextRecordsUrl.

tools.name: Query All (including deleted)
tools.description: Tool to execute SOQL queries including soft-deleted and archived records. Use when you need to query records that have been deleted via merge or delete operations, or when accessing archived Task and Event records.

tools.name: Query contacts by name
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Finds Salesforce Contact records by name using a case-insensitive search.

tools.name: Query report
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Executes a Salesforce report synchronously by its `id` and `reportType`, optionally with dynamic ad-hoc adjustments like filters or groupings, and returns its data without modifying the saved report.

tools.name: Get quick actions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve global and object-specific quick actions from Salesforce. Use when you need to list all available quick actions in the organization.

tools.name: Remove account by unique identifier
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Deletes an existing Salesforce Account using its unique ID, returning an empty response on success (HTTP 204).

tools.name: Remove a specific contact by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Permanently deletes a specific Contact from Salesforce using its unique ID, which must correspond to an existing record.

tools.name: Remove campaign object by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Permanently deletes a specific Campaign SObject in Salesforce using its unique ID.

tools.name: Remove from campaign
tools.description: Removes a lead or contact from a campaign by deleting the CampaignMember record. Provide either the member_id (lead/contact ID) or the specific campaign_member_id.

tools.name: Remove note object by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Permanently deletes an existing Salesforce Note object identified by its unique ID.

tools.name: Remove opportunity by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Permanently deletes an existing Salesforce Opportunity by its ID; if the Opportunity does not exist, a 'not found' (404) error occurs.

tools.name: Retrieve account data and error responses
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves comprehensive metadata for the Salesforce Account sObject, detailing its properties, recent records, and related resource URLs.

tools.name: Retrieve campaign data with error handling
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves comprehensive information and metadata for the Salesforce Campaign sObject, provided it is enabled and accessible in the organization, and features robust error handling.

tools.name: Retrieve contact object metadata
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves comprehensive metadata (e.g., fields, data types, picklist values) for the Salesforce Contact SObject; this action does not retrieve individual contact records.

tools.name: Retrieve lead by id
tools.description: Retrieves details for a Salesforce Lead by its ID; the specified Lead ID must exist in Salesforce.

tools.name: Retrieve lead data with various responses
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves Lead sObject data from Salesforce, such as recently viewed leads or general Lead object information.

tools.name: Retrieve note object information
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves comprehensive metadata for the Salesforce 'Note' SObject, if it is enabled and accessible, to understand its structure and capabilities.

tools.name: Retrieve opportunities data
tools.description: Retrieves all available Opportunity records, representing potential revenue-generating deals, from Salesforce.

tools.name: Retrieve opportunity by id with optional fields
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves a Salesforce Opportunity by its ID; the Opportunity ID must exist.

tools.name: Retrieve specific campaign object details
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves details for a specific Salesforce Campaign object by its ID, optionally limiting to specified fields; the Campaign object must exist.

tools.name: Retrieve specific contact by id
tools.description: Retrieves a Salesforce Contact by its unique ID; the ID must correspond to an existing Contact record in Salesforce.

tools.name: Run report
tools.description: Runs a report and returns the results. Creates a report instance that can be checked for completion.

tools.name: Run SOQL query
tools.description: Executes a SOQL query against Salesforce data. Returns records matching the query with pagination support.

tools.name: Execute SOSL search
tools.description: Executes a SOSL search query across multiple Salesforce objects. Use when you need to search for text across multiple object types simultaneously.

tools.name: Search accounts
tools.description: Search for Salesforce accounts using multiple criteria like name, industry, type, location, or contact information.

tools.name: Search campaigns
tools.description: Search for Salesforce campaigns using multiple criteria like name, type, status, date range, or active status. Requires access to the Campaign object (Marketing User feature must be enabled in the org).

tools.name: Search contacts
tools.description: Search for Salesforce contacts using multiple criteria like name, email, phone, account, or title.

tools.name: Search leads
tools.description: Search for Salesforce leads using multiple criteria like name, email, phone, company, title, status, or lead source.

tools.name: Search notes
tools.description: Search for Salesforce notes using multiple criteria like title, body content, parent record, owner, or creation date.

tools.name: Search opportunities
tools.description: Search for Salesforce opportunities using multiple criteria like name, account, stage, amount, close date, or status.

tools.name: Get search result layouts
tools.description: Retrieves search result layout information for specified Salesforce objects. Returns the list of fields displayed as columns, row limits, and labels for each object's search results page.

tools.name: Search suggested queries
tools.description: Returns a list of suggested searches based on the user's query string. Use when you want to help users discover relevant search terms before performing a search.

tools.name: Search suggested article title matches
tools.description: Search for Salesforce Knowledge articles with titles matching the search query. Returns auto-suggest results for Knowledge articles based on title matches.

tools.name: Search tasks
tools.description: Search for Salesforce tasks using multiple criteria like subject, status, priority, assigned user, related records, or dates.

tools.name: Send email
tools.description: Sends an email through Salesforce with options for recipients, attachments, and activity logging.

tools.name: Send email from template
tools.description: Sends an email using a predefined Salesforce email template with merge field support.

tools.name: Send mass email
tools.description: Sends bulk emails to multiple recipients, either using a template or custom content. Processes in batches for better performance.

tools.name: Set user password
tools.description: Tool to set or reset a user's password in Salesforce. Use when you need to assign a specific password or generate a random one for a user.

tools.name: Get approval layouts for sObject
tools.description: Tool to retrieve approval layouts for a specified Salesforce sObject. Use when you need to understand the approval process structure, fields, and layout configuration for an object. Available in REST API version 30.0 and later.

tools.name: Create multiple records (SObject Collections)
tools.description: Tool to create up to 200 records in one request with optional rollback. Use when you need to create multiple records of potentially different sObject types efficiently, reducing round-trips between client and server.

tools.name: Delete multiple records (SObject Collections)
tools.description: Tool to delete up to 200 records in one request with optional rollback. Use when you need to delete multiple records efficiently, reducing API calls.

tools.name: Get PlatformAction SObject metadata
tools.description: Retrieves metadata description of PlatformAction SObject. Use when you need to understand the structure and fields of PlatformAction for querying UI actions.

tools.name: Delete sObject record
tools.description: Tool to delete a record using the sObject Rows resource. Use when you need to permanently remove a specific record from Salesforce. A successful delete returns a 204 No Content status.

tools.name: Update sObject record
tools.description: Tool to update specific fields in an existing Salesforce sObject record. Use when you need to modify one or more fields in a record without affecting other fields.

tools.name: Create sObject tree
tools.description: Tool to create one or more sObject trees with root records of the specified type. Use when creating nested parent-child record hierarchies in a single atomic operation (e.g., Account with Contacts and Opportunities). Supports up to 200 total records across all trees, up to 5 levels deep, with maximum 5 different object types. All records succeed or all fail together.

tools.name: Get user password status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve password expiration status for a Salesforce user. Use when you need to check if a user's password has expired before performing API operations.

tools.name: Get standard invocable actions
tools.description: Retrieves the list of standard actions that can be statically invoked. Use when you need to discover available standard invocable actions like posting to Chatter, sending email, or sending custom notifications.

tools.name: Execute Tooling API query
tools.description: Tool to execute SOQL queries against Salesforce Tooling API metadata objects. Use when you need to query metadata components like ApexClass, ApexTrigger, ValidationRule, WorkflowRule, FieldDefinition, or EntityDefinition. The Tooling API exposes objects that use the external object framework and provides granular access to metadata components for development and deployment tasks.

tools.name: Update account
tools.description: Updates an existing account in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: Update account by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Updates specified fields of an existing Salesforce Account object identified by its unique ID; field names are case-sensitive and read-only fields are ignored.

tools.name: Update a favorite
tools.description: Tool to update a favorite's properties in Salesforce UI API. Use when you need to reorder favorites or modify their display properties.

tools.name: Update a record
tools.description: Tool to update a record's data in Salesforce via UI API. Use when you need to modify field values on an existing record. Salesforce validation rules are enforced. Pass If-Unmodified-Since header to prevent conflicts.

tools.name: Update campaign
tools.description: Updates an existing campaign in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: Update Campaign By ID
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Updates specific fields of an existing Campaign in Salesforce, identified by its unique `id`, which must already exist.

tools.name: Update contact
tools.description: Updates an existing contact in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: Update contact by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Updates specified fields of an existing Salesforce Contact by its ID; at least one field must be provided for modification.

tools.name: Update lead
tools.description: Updates an existing lead in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: Update lead by ID with JSON payload
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Updates specified fields of an existing Lead in Salesforce via its unique ID (path parameter), returning HTTP 204 on success or error details on failure; request body must contain at least one field to update.

tools.name: Update list view preferences
tools.description: Tool to update user preferences for a Salesforce list view including column widths, text wrapping, and display order. Use when you need to customize how columns appear in a list view.

tools.name: Update note
tools.description: Updates an existing note in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: Update opportunity
tools.description: Updates an existing opportunity in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: Update opportunity by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Updates specified fields of an existing Salesforce Opportunity by its ID; the Opportunity must exist, and some fields (like Name, StageName, CloseDate) may have specific Salesforce validation rules if being modified, while read-only fields update indirectly based on other changes.

tools.name: Update Related List Preferences
tools.description: Tool to update user preferences for a specific related list on an object in Salesforce. Use when customizing display settings such as column widths, text wrapping, column ordering, and sorting preferences for related lists.

tools.name: Update specific note by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use `update_specific_note_by_id` instead. Updates specified fields of an existing Salesforce Note SObject identified by its ID; the Note must already exist.

tools.name: Update task
tools.description: Updates an existing task in Salesforce with new information. Only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: Upload file to Salesforce Files
tools.description: Upload a file to Salesforce Files home via the Connect REST API. Use when you need to attach files to records or store them in a user's personal library. File size limit: 50 MB per request.

tools.name: Upload job data
tools.description: Tool to upload CSV data to a Salesforce Bulk API v2 ingest job. Use after creating a job and before closing it. Only ONE upload is allowed per job - multiple uploads will fail. After upload, close the job with state 'UploadComplete' to begin processing.

tools.name: Upsert sObject by External ID
tools.description: Tool to upsert records using sObject Rows by External ID. Use when you need to create or update a Salesforce record based on an external ID field value - creates a new record if the external ID doesn't exist, or updates the existing record if it does.

triggers.name: Account Created or Updated

Triggers when an Account is created or updated in Salesforce.

triggers.name: Contact Updated

Triggers when an existing Salesforce Contact record is modified.
    Emits changed fields alongside relevant timestamps.

triggers.name: Record Updated (Generic SObject)
triggers.description:
Triggers when monitored fields change on any Salesforce SObject. You specify the SObject type
    and which field values should be returned in the payload. The trigger uses SystemModstamp to
    detect changes regardless of which specific field changed.

triggers.name: New Lead Trigger

triggers.name: Task Created or Completed

Triggers when a Task is created or when its status changes to Completed in Salesforce.
    Supports optional filtering by task Status or Subject.

name: Calendly
description: Calendly is an appointment scheduling tool that automates meeting invitations, availability checks, and reminders, helping individuals and teams avoid email back-and-forth

tools.name: Cancel event
tools.description: Permanently cancels an existing, active scheduled event by its `uuid`, optionally providing a `reason`, which may trigger notifications to invitees.

tools.name: Cancel scheduled event
tools.description: Tool to cancel a scheduled Calendly event by creating a cancellation record. Use when you need to permanently cancel an existing, active event. The cancellation will trigger notifications to all invitees.

tools.name: Create event invitee
tools.description: Tool to programmatically schedule Calendly meetings without UI redirects. Use when you need to book a meeting on behalf of an invitee via API. Requires a paid Calendly plan.

tools.name: Create Event Type
tools.description: Tool to create a new one-on-one event type (kind: solo) in Calendly. Use when you need to programmatically create a new event type for scheduling meetings.

tools.name: Create an invitee no-show
tools.description: Marks an Invitee, identified by their existing and valid URI, as a 'No Show' for a scheduled event.

tools.name: Create One-Off Event Type
tools.description: Creates a temporary Calendly one-off event type for unique meetings outside regular availability, requiring valid host/co-host URIs, a future date/range for `date_setting`, and a positive `duration`.

tools.name: Create organization invitation
tools.description: Tool to invite a user to a Calendly organization via email. Use when you need to send an organization invitation to a new user.

tools.name: Create scheduling link
tools.description: Create a single-use scheduling link. Creates a scheduling link that can be used to book an event. The link allows invitees to schedule up to the specified maximum number of events. Once the limit is reached, the link becomes inactive.

tools.name: Create share
tools.description: Creates a customizable, one-time share link for a Calendly event type, allowing specific overrides to its settings (e.g., duration, availability, location) without altering the original event type.

tools.name: Create single use scheduling link
tools.description: Creates a one-time, single-use scheduling link for an active Calendly event type, expiring after one booking.

tools.name: Create webhook subscription
tools.description: Tool to create a webhook subscription for receiving Calendly event notifications. Use when you need to set up automated notifications for events like meeting bookings or cancellations. Organization scope triggers webhooks for all events organization-wide, while user/group scopes limit triggering to specific users or groups.

tools.name: Create webhook subscription
tools.description: Creates a Calendly webhook subscription to notify a specified `url` (which must be a publicly accessible HTTPS endpoint) for selected `events` within a given `organization` and `scope`.

tools.name: Delete invitee data
tools.description: Permanently removes all invitee data associated with the provided emails from past organization events, for data privacy compliance (requires Enterprise subscription; deletion may take up to one week).

tools.name: Delete invitee no show
tools.description: Deletes an Invitee No-Show record by its `uuid` to reverse an invitee's 'no-show' status; the `uuid` must refer to an existing record.

tools.name: Delete organization membership
tools.description: Tool to remove a user from a Calendly organization by membership UUID. Use when you need to revoke a user's access to an organization. Requires admin rights; organization owners cannot be removed.

tools.name: Delete scheduled event data
tools.description: For Enterprise users, initiates deletion of an organization's scheduled event data between a `start_time` and `end_time` (inclusive, where `start_time` must be <= `end_time`); actual data deletion may take up to 7 days to complete.

tools.name: Delete webhook subscription
tools.description: Deletes an existing webhook subscription to stop Calendly sending event notifications to its registered callback URL; this operation is idempotent.

tools.name: Get current user
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about the currently authenticated Calendly user.

tools.name: Get event
tools.description: Use to retrieve a specific Calendly scheduled event by its UUID, provided the event exists in the user's Calendly account.

tools.name: Get event invitee
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific invitee of a scheduled event, using their unique UUIDs.

tools.name: Get event type
tools.description: Retrieves details for a specific Calendly event type, identified by its UUID, which must be valid and correspond to an existing event type.

tools.name: Get event type availability
tools.description: Tool to retrieve availability schedules configured for a specific Calendly event type. Use when you need to get the availability rules including day-of-week schedules and date-specific overrides.

tools.name: Get group
tools.description: Retrieves all attributes of a specific Calendly group by its UUID; the group must exist.

tools.name: Get group relationship
tools.description: Retrieves a specific Calendly group relationship by its valid and existing UUID, providing details on user-group associations and membership.

tools.name: Get invitee no show
tools.description: Retrieves details for a specific Invitee No Show record by its UUID; an Invitee No Show is marked when an invitee does not attend a scheduled event.

tools.name: Get organization
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific Calendly organization. Use when you need to get organization details such as name, slug, or timestamps.

tools.name: Get organization invitation
tools.description: Retrieves a specific Calendly organization invitation using its UUID and the parent organization's UUID.

tools.name: Get organization membership
tools.description: Retrieves a specific Calendly organization membership by its UUID, returning all its attributes.

tools.name: Get routing form
tools.description: Retrieves a specific routing form by its UUID, providing its configuration details including questions and routing logic.

tools.name: Get routing form submission
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details about a specific routing form submission by its UUID. Use when you need submission details including questions, answers, and routing results.

tools.name: Get sample webhook data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve sample webhook payload data for testing webhook subscriptions. Use when you need to verify webhook setup and understand the data structure before creating actual webhook subscriptions.

tools.name: Get scheduled event
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific Calendly scheduled event by its UUID. Use when you need to check event status, timing, location, or invitee information.

tools.name: Get user
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for an existing Calendly user.

tools.name: Get user availability schedule
tools.description: Retrieves an existing user availability schedule by its UUID; this schedule defines the user's default hours of availability.

tools.name: Get webhook subscription
tools.description: Retrieves the details of an existing webhook subscription, identified by its UUID, including its callback URL, subscribed events, scope, and state.

tools.name: Mark invitee as no-show
tools.description: Tool to mark an invitee as a no-show for a scheduled event. Use when an invitee fails to attend their scheduled meeting and you need to record their absence in Calendly.

tools.name: Invite user to organization
tools.description: Invites a user to the specified Calendly organization by email, if they aren't already a member and lack a pending invitation to it.

tools.name: List activity log entries
tools.description: Retrieves a list of activity log entries for a specified Calendly organization (requires an active Enterprise subscription), supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

tools.name: List event invitees
tools.description: Retrieves a list of invitees for a specified Calendly event UUID, with options to filter by status or email, and sort by creation time.

tools.name: List events
tools.description: Retrieves a list of scheduled Calendly events. Exactly one of `user`, `organization`, or `group` must be provided to scope the query. The `invitee_email` parameter is a filter and cannot be used as a scope. Admin rights may be needed when filtering by `organization` or `group`.

tools.name: List event type available times
tools.description: Fetches available time slots for a Calendly event type within a specified time range; results are not paginated.

tools.name: List event type hosts
tools.description: Retrieves a list of hosts (users) assigned to a specific, existing Calendly event type, identified by its URI.

tools.name: List event type hosts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of event type hosts (memberships) for a specific event type. Use when you need to see which users are configured as hosts for an event type.

tools.name: List Event Types
tools.description: Tool to list all Event Types associated with a specified User or Organization. Use when you need to retrieve event types for a user or organization.

tools.name: List group relationships
tools.description: Retrieves a list of group relationships defining an owner's role (e.g., member, admin) within a group; an owner can have one membership per group but multiple admin roles across different groups.

tools.name: List groups
tools.description: Returns a list of groups for a specified Calendly organization URI, supporting pagination.

tools.name: List organization invitations
tools.description: Retrieves a list of invitations for a specific organization, identified by its UUID.

tools.name: List organization memberships
tools.description: Retrieves a list of organization memberships.

tools.name: List outgoing communications
tools.description: Retrieves a list of outgoing SMS communications for a specified organization; requires an Enterprise subscription and if filtering by creation date, both `min_created_at` and `max_created_at` must be provided to form a valid range.

tools.name: List routing forms
tools.description: Retrieves routing forms for a specified organization; routing forms are questionnaires used to direct invitees to appropriate booking pages or external URLs.

tools.name: List scheduled events
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of scheduled Calendly events. Use when you need to view events for a specific user, organization, or group. Requires exactly one of user, organization, or group parameter to scope the query.

tools.name: List user availability schedules
tools.description: Retrieves all availability schedules for the specified Calendly user.

tools.name: List user busy times
tools.description: Fetches a user's busy time intervals (internal and external calendar events) in ascending order for a period up to 7 days; keyset pagination is not supported.

tools.name: List User Meeting Locations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve configured meeting location information for a given Calendly user. Use when you need to see all available location options configured by a user for their meetings.

tools.name: List user event types
tools.description: Retrieves event types for a user or organization; requires either the `user` or `organization` URI.

tools.name: List webhook subscriptions
tools.description: Retrieves webhook subscriptions for a Calendly organization; `scope` determines if `user` or `group` URI is also required for filtering.

tools.name: Invite user to organization
tools.description: Tool to invite a user to a Calendly organization via email. Use when you need to send an organization invitation to a new user. Requires organization owner or admin privileges.

tools.name: Create Event Invitee
tools.description: Tool to create a new Event Invitee with standard notifications, calendar invites, reschedules, and workflows. Use when programmatically scheduling meetings via API. Requires paid Calendly plan (Standard+).

tools.name: Remove user from organization
tools.description: Removes a user (who is not an owner) from an organization by their membership UUID, requiring administrative privileges.

tools.name: Revoke a user's organization invitation
tools.description: Revokes a pending and revokable (not yet accepted or expired) organization invitation using its UUID and the organization's UUID, rendering the invitation link invalid.

tools.name: Get scheduled event
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific scheduled Calendly event. Use when you need to fetch details of a scheduled event using its UUID.

tools.name: Update Event Type
tools.description: Tool to update an existing one-on-one event type (kind: solo) in Calendly. Use when you need to modify event type settings such as name, duration, location, or description. NOTE: Currently only supports one-on-one event types.

tools.name: Update Event Type Availability
tools.description: Tool to update an event type availability schedule in Calendly. Use when you need to change the timezone or availability rules for an event type. WARNING: Updating rules will overwrite all existing rules - retrieve existing rules first using GET /event_type_availability_schedules.

name: Trello
description: A web-based, kanban-style, list-making application.

tools.name: Add board
tools.description: Creates a new Trello board; the 'name' parameter is required for creation, and various preferences can be customized or cloned from a source board.

tools.name: Generate board calendar key
tools.description: Generates a new calendar key for the Trello board specified by `idBoard`, invalidating any previous key for that board.

tools.name: Add checklist to card
tools.description: Creates a new, initially empty checklist with a given name on an existing Trello card. Checklists are created on cards, not boards.

tools.name: Generate email key for board
tools.description: Generates a new email key for the Trello board specified by idBoard to enable or reset adding cards via email; this invalidates any previously existing email key for the board.

tools.name: Add a label to a board
tools.description: Creates a new label on an existing Trello board.

tools.name: Add new list to board
tools.description: Creates a new, empty list on a specified, existing Trello board, typically used as a column or category for organizing cards.

tools.name: Mark board as viewed
tools.description: Marks the Trello board specified by idBoard as viewed for the current user, exclusively updating its viewed status and potentially influencing its position in user-specific lists and notification settings.

tools.name: Add board power-up
tools.description: Enables the Power-Up specified by the 'value' parameter on the board; processes one Power-Up enablement per call.

tools.name: Add card
tools.description: Creates a new card in a Trello list. Only `idList` is required; `idBoard` is optional as the API determines the board from the list.

tools.name: Add comment to card
tools.description: Adds a new text comment, which can include @mentions, to a Trello card specified by its ID; file attachments are not supported via this action.

tools.name: Add attachment to card
tools.description: Adds an attachment to a Trello card by `idCard`; specify either a `file` to upload or a `url` to link, but not both.

tools.name: Add check item to checklist
tools.description: Adds a new check item to an existing checklist on a specific Trello card.

tools.name: Add checklist to card via id
tools.description: Adds a checklist to a Trello card: use `value` to add a specific existing checklist, `idChecklistSource` to create a new checklist by copying an existing one (optionally using `name` for the new checklist's name), or `name` to create a new empty checklist from scratch.

tools.name: Add label to card
tools.description: Adds an existing label to a Trello card; `idCard` identifies the card and `value` is the ID of the label to add. Both card and label must already exist.

tools.name: Add card member by id
tools.description: Assigns a Trello member to a specific Trello card by card ID (or short link) and member ID.

tools.name: Add labels to card
tools.description: Adds a label to an existing Trello card (specified by `idCard`), defining the label by `name` and either `color` or the overriding `value` (which specifies color by name); a new label is created on the board if a matching one (by name/color combination) doesn't already exist.

tools.name: Add member vote to card
tools.description: Casts a 'yes' vote for a specified member on a Trello card; a member can only vote once per card.

tools.name: Add sticker to card
tools.description: Adds a sticker to a Trello card, using a default sticker name (e.g., 'taco-cool') or a custom sticker ID for the image, and allows specifying its position, rotation, and z-index.

tools.name: Add checklist to card
tools.description: Creates a new checklist on a Trello card, either by name or by copying from `idChecklistSource`, targeting an `idCard` or `idBoard`; this action creates only the checklist structure, not its items.

tools.name: Add check item to checklist
tools.description: Adds a new check item to a specified Trello checklist; this action does not update existing check items.

tools.name: Create label on board
tools.description: Creates a new label with a specified name (required) and color on a Trello board (idBoard required); this action defines the label but does not apply it to cards.

tools.name: Add new list to board
tools.description: Creates a new list on a specified Trello board, with options to copy an existing list, set its position, initial state (archived/subscribed), and does not modify existing lists or move cards.

tools.name: Archive all cards in list
tools.description: Archives all cards in a Trello list; while cards can be restored via the Trello interface, this action does not provide an unarchive function.

tools.name: Add card to list
tools.description: Creates a new card in a Trello list, which must be specified by an existing and accessible `idList`.

tools.name: Move all cards in list to another list
tools.description: Moves all cards from a source Trello list to a destination list on a specified board. This action is irreversible, moves (not copies) cards, and empties the source list without deleting it.

tools.name: Upload member avatar
tools.description: Updates a Trello member's avatar using a base64-encoded image; the `file` field, though schema-optional, requires valid image data for a successful update.

tools.name: Add member board background
tools.description: Adds a new custom board background, from an image file, to a specified Trello member's collection, making it available for their use but not applying it to any board.

tools.name: Add board star to member
tools.description: Stars a Trello board for a member (does not remove or list stars), optionally at a specified position; the board must exist and be accessible to the member.

tools.name: Add custom board background for a member
tools.description: Adds a new custom board background for a specified Trello member; either a `file` (image upload) or a `url` (external image URL) must be provided.

tools.name: Add custom emoji for a member
tools.description: Adds a new custom emoji using an image file and a unique name to a Trello member's account; this emoji is member-specific and not shared across the workspace.

tools.name: Add custom sticker for member
tools.description: Uploads a custom sticker to a Trello member's collection, if the member's plan allows custom stickers and respects associated limits.

tools.name: Add saved search for member
tools.description: Creates a new saved search with a specified name, position, and query for a Trello member.

tools.name: Mark all notifications as read
tools.description: Marks all Trello notifications for the authenticated user as read across all boards; this action is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Create organization
tools.description: Creates a new Trello organization (Workspace) with a `displayName` (required), and optionally a description, website, and various preferences (e.g., board visibility, member invitation restrictions).

tools.name: Add organization logo
tools.description: Sets or updates the logo for a Trello organization; the provided image file must adhere to Trello's format and size restrictions.

tools.name: Create new session
tools.description: Creates or updates a Trello user session, optionally linking it to a specific board for status updates and setting the user's activity status.

tools.name: Add token webhook
tools.description: Creates a webhook for a Trello token to monitor a Trello model (`idModel`) and send notifications to a `callbackURL`, which must be publicly accessible and able to respond to Trello's HEAD validation request.

tools.name: Convert checklist item to card
tools.description: Converts a checklist item into a new card (useful for promoting a subtask), which inherits some properties from the item; this is irreversible via the API and offers no customization during conversion.

tools.name: Delete action by id
tools.description: Deletes a specific Trello action, such as a `commentCard`, by its ID; this is an irreversible operation and only applies to deletable action types, as many (especially system-generated) actions cannot be deleted.

tools.name: Delete member from board
tools.description: Permanently removes a current member from a Trello board, revoking their access; this action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete Power-Up from board
tools.description: Disables a Power-Up on a Trello board using the board's ID and the plugin ID of a Power-Up currently enabled on that board; this action is irreversible and may result in data loss.

tools.name: Delete card action comment
tools.description: Deletes a specific comment action (identified by `idAction`) from a Trello card (identified by `idCard`); this operation is irreversible and only affects comments.

tools.name: Delete card attachment
tools.description: Permanently removes a specified attachment from a Trello card; this action is irreversible and requires that both the card and the attachment exist.

tools.name: Delete card by ID
tools.description: Permanently deletes an archived Trello card specified by its `idCard`.

tools.name: Delete card checklist
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific checklist from a Trello card.

tools.name: Remove label from card
tools.description: Removes a specific label from a Trello card; the label itself is not deleted from the board, only its association with the card.

tools.name: Remove member from card
tools.description: Removes a currently assigned member from a Trello card, affecting only the card's member list and not the member's board membership or overall permissions.

tools.name: Delete card label by color
tools.description: Permanently removes a specific `color` label from an existing Trello card identified by `idCard`, if the card has that label; this only disassociates the label from the card, not deleting the label definition itself.

tools.name: Delete member vote from card
tools.description: Removes a member's vote from a Trello card. The operation requires the member to have already voted on the card; attempting to delete a non-existent vote returns a 400 error. Voting must be enabled on the board.

tools.name: Delete card sticker
tools.description: Permanently removes a specific sticker (identified by `idSticker`) from a Trello card (identified by `idCard`).

tools.name: Delete checklist item
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific check item from a checklist on a Trello card; this operation is irreversible and only affects the specified item, not the entire checklist.

tools.name: Delete checklist by id
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a Trello checklist and all its items using the `idChecklist`.

tools.name: Delete label by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing label from a Trello board by its ID; this operation is irreversible via the API.

tools.name: Delete member board background
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific custom board background belonging to the specified Trello member; this operation cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete member custom sticker
tools.description: Deletes a custom sticker from a Trello member's collection; this permanent action is only available for custom stickers within a Trello Workspace on a paid plan.

tools.name: Delete member saved search
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific saved search for a Trello member, used when the search is outdated or no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete member board star
tools.description: Removes a specific starred board (identified by `idBoardStar`) from a Trello member's (identified by `idMember`) list of favorites; `idBoardStar` must be an existing star for that member.

tools.name: Delete organization by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes a Trello organization and all its associated data; this action is irreversible and requires caution.

tools.name: Delete organization logo by id
tools.description: Deletes an existing Trello organization's custom logo, restoring its default and leaving other settings unchanged; if no custom logo exists, it succeeds without effect.

tools.name: Delete member from organization
tools.description: Removes a member entirely from a specific Trello organization, including from all its boards and cards; this action is permanent and does not delete the member's Trello account.

tools.name: Delete organization member by IDs
tools.description: Permanently removes a member from a Trello organization by ID, revoking all access to its content; re-invitation is required for renewed access, and this does not delete the member's Trello account.

tools.name: Delete org invite restriction
tools.description: Removes a previously set email address invitation restriction from a Trello organization. This is an Enterprise-only feature that requires admin privileges on the organization.

tools.name: Delete org associated domain
tools.description: Irreversibly deletes an associated email domain from a Trello organization's preferences to update email domain restrictions for workspace membership; the domain must be currently associated for removal.

tools.name: Delete token
tools.description: Deletes a specific Trello API token, identified by its value in the path, permanently revoking its access; this action is irreversible and used to invalidate compromised or unneeded tokens.

tools.name: Delete token webhook by id
tools.description: Deletes an existing webhook, specified by its `idWebhook`, thereby stopping its notifications.

tools.name: Delete webhook by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing Trello webhook by its `idWebhook`, an irreversible action that stops future notifications.

tools.name: Dismiss member message
tools.description: Dismisses a one-time message for a Trello member, adding it to their dismissed messages list. This endpoint marks a specific one-time message (notification, banner, or prompt) as dismissed for the specified member. Once dismissed, the message will not be shown to the user again. Common use cases include dismissing onboarding messages, feature announcements, or team-specific prompts. Requires write access to the member's account. Use 'me' as idMember for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Get board by action id
tools.description: Retrieves details for the Trello board associated with a specific action ID, returning board information only.

tools.name: Get action's board field
tools.description: Retrieves a specified `field` from the Trello board associated with the provided Trello `idAction`.

tools.name: Get action by ID
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Trello action by its ID.

tools.name: Get action field by id
tools.description: Retrieves the value of a specific field (e.g., 'data', 'date', 'type') from a Trello action using its unique ID.

tools.name: Get card by action ID
tools.description: Retrieves Trello card details for a given `idAction`, which must be an action specifically linked to a card; returns only card data, not action details.

tools.name: Get action's card field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field from the Trello card associated with the given action ID.

tools.name: Get action display by ID
tools.description: Retrieves a display-friendly representation of an existing and accessible Trello action for UI/report purposes, providing presentation-focused data instead of full raw details and without altering the action.

tools.name: Get action entities by id
tools.description: Retrieves all entities (e.g., boards, lists, cards, members) associated with a specific, existing Trello action ID.

tools.name: Get an action's list
tools.description: Retrieves the Trello list associated with a specific Trello action ID, for actions linked to a list.

tools.name: Get field of action's list
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field of the list associated with a Trello action, returning only that single field's value.

tools.name: Get action's member by id
tools.description: Retrieves the Trello member who was the subject of an action (not the creator). This endpoint returns information about the member who was acted upon in actions like: - addMemberToCard: Returns the member who was added to a card - removeMemberFromCard: Returns the member who was removed from a card - addMemberToBoard: Returns the member who was added to a board Note: For actions that don't involve a member as a subject (e.g., createCard, createBoard), this endpoint returns 404. Use /actions/{idAction}/memberCreator to get the action's creator instead.

tools.name: Get Action Subject Member Field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field of the member who was the subject of a Trello action. This is distinct from 'memberCreator' (who performed the action). Only works for actions that involve a member as the subject (e.g., addMemberToBoard, addMemberToCard, removeMemberFromCard). Returns a single field value for optimized data retrieval.

tools.name: Fetch action member creator
tools.description: Retrieves details about the Trello member who created the action with the given `idAction`.

tools.name: Get action member creator field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field from the profile of the Trello member who created a given action. Use this to get targeted information like username, fullName, initials, avatarHash, or url from an action's creator.

tools.name: Fetch organization action by id
tools.description: Fetches the organization details for a given Trello action, if the action has an associated organization.

tools.name: Get action's organization field
tools.description: Retrieves the value of a specific `field` for the organization associated with a Trello `idAction`; use if the action has an organization and you need only that field (e.g., 'name', 'id', 'url').

tools.name: Get batch
tools.description: Executes multiple Trello API GET requests in a single batch operation for efficient bulk data retrieval.

tools.name: Get board actions by id
tools.description: Retrieves actions (e.g., card creations, comments) for a Trello board by its ID, useful for activity tracking; the board must exist.

tools.name: Get board stars by board ID
tools.description: Retrieves board stars (user-marked favorites) for a specified Trello board, where `idBoard` must be an existing board; use to list a user's starred boards or all stars on a particular board.

tools.name: Get board by id
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive details for a specific Trello board by its ID; this is a read-only action.

tools.name: Get board field
tools.description: Retrieves the value of a single, specified field from a Trello board.

tools.name: Get cards by board ID
tools.description: Retrieves cards from an existing Trello board, allowing filtering and customization of fields for cards, attachments, and members.

tools.name: Get cards by filter from board
tools.description: Retrieves cards from a specified Trello board, filtered by 'all' (all cards), 'closed' (archived only), 'open' (non-archived), or 'visible' (cards on non-archived lists).

tools.name: Get card from board
tools.description: Retrieves details for a specific Trello card by its ID and its parent board's ID, with options to customize returned fields for the card and associated data like attachments, actions, members, and checklists.

tools.name: Get board checklists
tools.description: Retrieves checklists (primarily structure/metadata, not detailed item history) from a Trello board, with options to include associated card and check item details and to control which fields are returned for each entity.

tools.name: Retrieve board deltas
tools.description: Retrieves recent changes (deltas) for a Trello board by its ID, allowing tracking of modifications since a specified update sequence number (`ixLastUpdate`).

tools.name: Get board labels by ID
tools.description: Fetches labels for a specified Trello board, aiding in its organization or label management; this action does not detail per-card label usage.

tools.name: Get a board label
tools.description: Fetches specified fields for a specific label on a Trello board; this read-only action does not return information about which cards the label is attached to.

tools.name: Get board's lists
tools.description: Retrieves lists from a specified Trello board, with options to filter lists and include card details.

tools.name: Get board lists by filter
tools.description: Fetches lists by status from an accessible Trello board; card details for these lists require a separate call.

tools.name: Get board members
tools.description: Retrieves members of a Trello board, with options to filter the list and select specific member fields to return.

tools.name: Get board members filtered
tools.description: Retrieves members of a Trello board using a specified filter, assuming the board exists and the filter is valid.

tools.name: Get member cards from board
tools.description: Retrieves cards for a member on a board, with options to customize returned fields and related data; member must have board access.

tools.name: List board memberships
tools.description: Retrieves Trello board memberships (user roles and permissions) for auditing access or managing collaboration, returning only membership data and not other board content.

tools.name: Get board membership
tools.description: Retrieves a specific membership on a Trello board by its ID, optionally including member details.

tools.name: Get invited board members
tools.description: Retrieves a list of members invited to a specific Trello board who have not yet joined.

tools.name: Retrieve invited board member field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field (e.g., email, username) for members who have been invited to a Trello board but have not yet joined.

tools.name: Get my board preferences
tools.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's preferences for a specific Trello board.

tools.name: Get board organization
tools.description: Fetches information about the Trello Workspace (organization) to which a specific board belongs, returning details for the Workspace only, not the board itself or its content.

tools.name: Get board organization field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field from the organization associated with a Trello board, useful for obtaining targeted details without fetching the entire organization object.

tools.name: Get card actions by id
tools.description: Retrieves the history of actions (e.g., comments, updates, moves) for a Trello card specified by `idCard`; the card must exist and very old actions might not be available.

tools.name: Get card attachments
tools.description: Retrieves attachments for a Trello card.

tools.name: Get specific card attachment
tools.description: Retrieves a specific attachment from a Trello card by card ID and attachment ID.

tools.name: Get board by card id
tools.description: Fetches detailed information about the Trello board to which a specific, existing, and accessible card belongs, using the card's ID or short link.

tools.name: Get board field by card ID
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field from the board associated with a given Trello card.

tools.name: Get card by ID
tools.description: Retrieves a Trello card by its ID or shortlink, with options to include related data like actions, attachments, members, and checklists.

tools.name: Get card field by id
tools.description: Retrieves the value of a single, specified field from a Trello card.

tools.name: Get card check item states
tools.description: Gets the completed checklist items on a Trello card. Note: This endpoint only returns check items marked as 'complete', not incomplete items. Returns item IDs and states, not full checklist or card details.

tools.name: Get card checklists by ID
tools.description: Retrieves all checklists, including their check items, for a Trello card specified by its ID or shortlink, if the card exists and is accessible.

tools.name: Get card custom field items
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a card's customFieldItems array. Use when you need structured metadata from custom fields for automation.

tools.name: Get list by card ID
tools.description: Gets the Trello list to which a specified card (which must exist) belongs.

tools.name: Get card list field
tools.description: Fetches a specific field from the Trello list that a given card belongs to.

tools.name: Get card members
tools.description: Retrieves members of a Trello card, identified by its ID or shortLink, allowing customization of which member fields are returned.

tools.name: Get card members voted
tools.description: Fetches members who voted on a Trello card; requires an existing card ID, the Voting Power-Up to be active on the board, and members to have voted; returns member details, not vote counts.

tools.name: Get card stickers by ID card
tools.description: Retrieves all visual stickers (used for categorization, emphasis, or decoration) from an existing and accessible Trello card; this read-only action does not affect other card elements.

tools.name: Get card sticker by id
tools.description: Call this action to retrieve detailed properties (like image, position, rotation) of a specific sticker on a Trello card.

tools.name: Get check item by id
tools.description: Retrieves a specific check item from a checklist using the checklist ID and check item ID.

tools.name: Get board for a checklist
tools.description: Retrieves the Trello board a specific checklist belongs to, using the checklist ID.

tools.name: Get checklist's board field
tools.description: Retrieves a specified `field` (e.g., 'name', 'desc') from the Trello board associated with the given `idChecklist`.

tools.name: Get checklist by ID
tools.description: Fetches a Trello checklist by its `idChecklist`, requiring the ID to refer to an existing checklist, and allows specifying which details of the checklist, its cards, and check items are returned.

tools.name: Get checklist field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field's value from a Trello checklist by its ID and the field name, without loading the entire checklist object or its items.

tools.name: Get checklist cards
tools.description: Retrieves cards associated with a specific, valid Trello checklist ID, allowing for filtering and customization of card and related entity data fields.

tools.name: Get cards from a checklist by filter
tools.description: Retrieves cards from a specified Trello checklist, filterable by card ID or status (e.g., 'all', 'open'), noting the response is a single card object even if the filter could match multiple cards.

tools.name: Get checklist items by ID
tools.description: Retrieves all check items from a Trello checklist. Returns item details including name, position, completion state, and optionally due dates and assigned members.

tools.name: Get board by label ID
tools.description: Retrieves the Trello board to which a given, valid Trello label ID (`idLabel`) belongs.

tools.name: Retrieve board field by label id
tools.description: Retrieves a specified `field` (e.g., 'name', 'url') from the Trello board associated with a given `idLabel`.

tools.name: Get label by id
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific Trello label by its ID, allowing selection of specific fields to return.

tools.name: Get list actions by ID
tools.description: Retrieves actions (like card movements or comments, newest first) for a Trello list by its ID, to track history or create activity logs.

tools.name: Get board by list ID
tools.description: Retrieves the board to which a specific Trello list belongs.

tools.name: Get board field by list ID
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field (e.g., 'name', 'desc', 'url') from the Trello board associated with a given list ID. Useful when you only have a list ID and need board information without fetching the full board object.

tools.name: Get list by ID
tools.description: Retrieves a Trello list by its unique ID, optionally including details for its cards and parent board.

tools.name: Get list field value
tools.description: Fetches the value of a single, specified field from a Trello list.

tools.name: Get cards in a list
tools.description: Fetches cards from a Trello list by its ID, with options to filter and customize the returned card data.

tools.name: Get list cards by filter
tools.description: Retrieves cards from a specific Trello list, filtered by criteria like 'open', 'closed', or 'all'.

tools.name: Get Member Board Background
tools.description: Retrieves a specific custom board background for a Trello member by its ID. Note: Only custom backgrounds (uploaded by the user) can be retrieved; built-in defaults like 'blue' or 'gradient-ocean' are not accessible via this endpoint.

tools.name: Get member custom board background
tools.description: Retrieves metadata (e.g., brightness, URLs, tiling status) for a specific custom board background of a Trello member, not the image file itself.

tools.name: Get member custom emoji
tools.description: Retrieves a specific custom emoji by its ID for a Trello member, requiring that both the member and emoji exist and are associated.

tools.name: Get member custom sticker
tools.description: Retrieves a specific custom sticker by ID for a Trello member; returns only sticker data (not its usage on cards/boards), with optional field selection.

tools.name: Get member actions by ID
tools.description: Retrieves a list of actions for a specified Trello member, allowing filtering by type, date, models, and control over output format and fields.

tools.name: Get Member Saved Search
tools.description: Fetches the details of a specific saved search for a Trello member; this does not execute the search.

tools.name: Get member board backgrounds
tools.description: Fetches the board backgrounds for a specified Trello member.

tools.name: Get member boards by id
tools.description: Retrieves board-level details (not lists/cards) for Trello boards associated with a member ID or username, allowing extensive customization of the returned data.

tools.name: Get member boards with filter
tools.description: Retrieves a list of boards for a specific Trello member, applying a filter such as 'open', 'starred', or 'all'.

tools.name: Get member's invited boards
tools.description: Retrieves Trello boards to which a specific member has been invited but has not yet joined.

tools.name: Get member's invited board field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field from Trello boards to which a member has been invited but not yet joined; returns an empty result for no pending invitations.

tools.name: Get member board stars
tools.description: Fetches only the boards a specific Trello member has starred, identified by their ID or username.

tools.name: Get member board star
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific board star (a Trello board marked as a favorite) for a given Trello member.

tools.name: Get member by ID
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive information about a Trello member, specified by ID or username, including profile, activities, boards, cards, notifications, and organization affiliations, with customizable detail levels via filters and field parameters.

tools.name: Get member field by ID
tools.description: Efficiently retrieves a specific field (e.g., fullName, username, bio) of a Trello member using their ID or username, without fetching the entire member profile.

tools.name: Get cards by member ID
tools.description: Retrieves cards for a Trello member, specified by ID or username, with options to filter cards and include related data like actions, attachments, and checklists.

tools.name: Get member cards by filter
tools.description: Retrieves all cards assigned to a Trello member, filtered by status. Use 'me' as idMember for the authenticated user. Returns card details including name, description, board, list, labels, due date, and URL.

tools.name: Retrieve member custom board backgrounds
tools.description: Retrieves custom board backgrounds for a Trello member, who must exist, using their ID or username.

tools.name: Get member custom emoji
tools.description: Retrieves all custom (user-specific, non-standard) emojis that a specified Trello member has created or can access.

tools.name: Get member custom stickers
tools.description: Retrieves a member's custom stickers, which are unique personalized stickers created by them, distinct from standard Trello stickers.

tools.name: Get member deltas by ID
tools.description: Retrieves a chronological list of all changes (deltas) made by a specific Trello member, including modifications to boards, lists, and cards, to audit activity or sync data.

tools.name: Get member notifications by id
tools.description: Retrieves notifications for a Trello member, specified by their ID or username, with options for filtering and pagination.

tools.name: Get member notifications by filter
tools.description: Retrieves a list of a Trello member's notifications, filtered by specified types.

tools.name: Get a specified member's organizations
tools.description: Fetches organizations a specific Trello member belongs to; the `idMember` must be an ID or username of an existing Trello member.

tools.name: Get member organizations by filter
tools.description: Fetches a list of organizations a specific Trello member belongs to, using a filter to narrow down the results.

tools.name: Retrieve member s invited organizations
tools.description: Retrieves organizations a Trello member has been invited to but has not yet accepted or declined.

tools.name: Get field of member's invited organization
tools.description: Get a specific field of an organization to which the member has a pending invitation; returns data only if such an invitation exists.

tools.name: Get member saved searches
tools.description: Retrieves all saved search queries for a Trello member; this action only retrieves saved searches and does not execute them.

tools.name: Retrieve member tokens
tools.description: Retrieves API token metadata for a Trello member. Returns information about all API tokens associated with the specified member, including token ID, creation date, expiration date, permissions, and the application that created each token. For security reasons, the actual token values are not included in the response. Note: You can only retrieve tokens for your own account (use 'me' or your own member ID). Attempting to access another member's tokens will fail.

tools.name: Get notification creator field
tools.description: Fetches a specific field of the member who created the specified Trello notification.

tools.name: Get notification organization field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field from the Trello organization associated with a given notification, provided the notification is linked to an organization.

tools.name: Get notification board by ID
tools.description: Gets the Trello board associated with a given notification ID, returning only board data and allowing selection of specific board fields.

tools.name: Get notification's board field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field from the board associated with a Trello notification. This endpoint is useful when you only need a single piece of information about the board (like its name or URL) without fetching all board data. The notification must belong to the authenticated user and must be associated with a board (e.g., board invitations, card comments, or mentions on board-related items).

tools.name: Get notification by ID
tools.description: Retrieves a specific Trello notification by its ID, optionally including related entities and specific fields for the notification and its related entities.

tools.name: Get a notification field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field from a Trello notification.

tools.name: Get notification's card
tools.description: Retrieves the card associated with a Trello notification. Returns card details for card-related notifications (e.g., comments on cards, card assignments, due date reminders). The notification must exist and be linked to a card; notifications without card context (e.g., board-level notifications) will return an error.

tools.name: Get notification card field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field of a Trello card, using the ID of a notification that is directly associated with that card.

tools.name: Get notification display by id
tools.description: Retrieves the information needed to display an existing Trello notification, identified by its ID, without altering the notification or fetching its complete metadata.

tools.name: Get Notification Entities
tools.description: Retrieves the entities (members, cards, boards, lists, etc.) associated with a specific Trello notification. Returns an ordered list of entity objects that together describe what happened in the notification. This is useful for building human-readable notification descriptions and activity feeds. For example, a 'mentionedOnCard' notification returns entities like: [member, "mentioned you on", card] which can be combined to display: "John mentioned you on 'My Card'" Note: Requires a valid notification ID that belongs to the authenticated user.

tools.name: Retrieve notification list by id
tools.description: Retrieves the Trello list associated with a specific notification ID, for notifications linked to a list (e.g., card creation or movement notifications).

tools.name: Get notification list field
tools.description: Efficiently retrieves a single specified field from a Trello list linked to a notification, avoiding fetching the entire list.

tools.name: Get notification member by id
tools.description: Fetches details of the member (not the notification content itself) associated with a specific Trello notification ID.

tools.name: Retrieve notification member field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field value of the Trello member associated with a notification. Use this to get individual member properties (like fullName, username, email, etc.) for the member who is the subject of a notification. This is useful when you only need a single piece of member information rather than the full member object.

tools.name: Get member creator of a notification
tools.description: Fetches the creator (member) of a Trello notification, identified by `idNotification`, returning only creator details and respecting Trello privacy settings and user permissions.

tools.name: Get notification organization
tools.description: Retrieves the Trello organization linked to a specific notification ID; returns organization details only, not the notification itself.

tools.name: Get organization actions by ID
tools.description: Retrieves a log of actions (e.g., card creations, list movements, comments) for a specified Trello organization, filterable by type, date range, and models; `idOrg` must be a valid organization ID/name, and `page` * `limit` must be < 1000.

tools.name: Get organization boards
tools.description: Fetches boards for a Trello organization, specified by its ID or name, with options to filter and customize returned data.

tools.name: Get organization boards by filter
tools.description: Fetches a list of boards belonging to a specific Trello organization, filtered by a given criterion.

tools.name: Get organization by ID
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Trello organization, including optional related resources like members, boards, and actions, using its ID or unique name.

tools.name: Get organization field by id
tools.description: Retrieves the value of a single specified `field` for a Trello organization `idOrg`, ideal for efficiently fetching a specific piece of information without loading the full organization details.

tools.name: Get organization deltas by id
tools.description: Retrieves a log of recent modifications (deltas) for a Trello organization, filterable by tags and supporting incremental fetching via an update index.

tools.name: Retrieve organization members by id
tools.description: Retrieves members of a Trello organization (specified by ID or name), with an option to include member activity if the organization is Premium.

tools.name: Get organization members by filter
tools.description: Fetches members of a specified Trello organization using a filter. Valid filters are 'all' (all members), 'normal' (regular members), or 'admins' (administrators).

tools.name: Get organization member cards
tools.description: Fetches all cards assigned to a specific member of a given Trello organization.

tools.name: Get organization memberships
tools.description: Fetches organization-level memberships for a Trello organization, with options to filter members and include their details; does not return board-specific memberships.

tools.name: Get organization membership
tools.description: Retrieves a specific membership within a Trello organization, using their respective IDs, to ascertain the member's role, status, or permissions.

tools.name: Get invited organization members
tools.description: Retrieves members invited to a Trello organization who have not yet accepted their invitation, returning only data for pending invitations (not active or former members) and cannot send or modify invitations.

tools.name: Get organization invited member field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific `field` (e.g., fullName, username, email, status) for members with pending invitations to the Trello organization specified by `idOrg`.

tools.name: Search Trello
tools.description: Searches Trello content (e.g., boards, cards, members) within specified organizations using a query and customizable result fields. IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS: - Search indexing has a delay: newly created/updated cards may not appear for several minutes. - For exact name matching or time-sensitive lookups, use TRELLO_GET_LISTS_CARDS_BY_ID_LIST or TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_CARDS_BY_ID_BOARD to enumerate cards directly, then filter by name. - The search uses word tokenization: queries like 'Payment failed when sending tips' are split into individual terms ['Payment', 'failed', 'when', 'sending', 'tips']. Common words may be ignored. - Set partial='true' (default) for better recall with prefix matching on the last search term.

tools.name: Search for members
tools.description: Searches Trello members by name, username, or email, optionally scoped to a board or organization.

tools.name: Get sessions socket
tools.description: Retrieves WebSocket session connection information from Trello for real-time updates. IMPORTANT: This endpoint is an internal Trello endpoint that is NOT part of the public REST API. It requires WebSocket protocol and browser session authentication, making it inaccessible via standard API tokens. For real-time updates, use Trello Webhooks instead.

tools.name: Get token by token
tools.description: Retrieves information about a specific Trello API token, allowing selection of specific fields and inclusion of webhook details.

tools.name: Get token field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field from a Trello token, provided the token is valid, has necessary permissions, and the field is a valid token field.

tools.name: Get token member
tools.description: Retrieves information about the Trello member associated with the current API token, allowing customization of the returned fields.

tools.name: Retrieve token member field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field for the Trello member associated with the current API token. The token is automatically extracted from authentication, so only the field name needs to be specified.

tools.name: Get webhooks for token
tools.description: Retrieves all webhooks associated with a specific Trello API token.

tools.name: Get token webhook by ID
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific Trello webhook, identified by `idWebhook`, that is associated with the given `token`.

tools.name: Get type by id
tools.description: Identifies the type of a Trello resource (member or organization) given its ID. Returns a 'type' field indicating whether the resource is a 'member' or 'organization'. Note: This endpoint only works for members and organizations; boards, cards, and lists are not supported.

tools.name: Get webhook by ID
tools.description: Retrieves the full configuration and status for a specific Trello webhook by its unique ID; this action does not return past notification history.

tools.name: Get webhook field by id
tools.description: Gets a specific field's value from a Trello webhook, avoiding retrieval of the full webhook object.

tools.name: Mark card notifications read
tools.description: Marks all notifications associated with a specific Trello card as read; this is irreversible and only affects read status, not deleting or modifying notifications.

tools.name: Remove checklist item
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific checklist item from a checklist on a Trello card using their respective IDs.

tools.name: Remove member's custom board background
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific custom board background (identified by `idBoardBackground`) associated with an existing Trello member (identified by `idMember`).

tools.name: Update action text
tools.description: Updates the `text` field of a specific Trello comment action, identified by `idAction`.

tools.name: Update action text
tools.description: Updates the text of an existing Trello action (e.g., a comment or card update) identified by `idAction`; this change only affects the action's text content.

tools.name: Update board membership
tools.description: Updates a user's role (e.g., admin, normal, observer) on a specific Trello board or retrieves updated member details, requiring existing board and membership IDs.

tools.name: Update board by ID
tools.description: Updates attributes (e.g., name, description, status, preferences) of an existing Trello board identified by `idBoard`.
