name: Lever
description: Lever is an applicant tracking system combining sourcing, CRM functionalities, and analytics, helping companies scale recruiting efforts with a collaborative approach

tools.name: Add Opportunity Links
tools.description: Tool to add links to a contact associated with an opportunity. Use when you need to attach URLs like LinkedIn profiles, GitHub accounts, personal websites, or other social media links to a candidate. Adding new links does not replace existing links.

tools.name: Add Opportunity Sources
tools.description: Tool to add sources to an opportunity. Use when you need to attribute specific recruitment channels or sources to an existing opportunity.

tools.name: Add Opportunity Tags
tools.description: Tool to add tags to an opportunity. Use when you need to append labels or categorize an existing opportunity.

tools.name: Create Form Submission
tools.description: Tool to create a completed profile form submission for a candidate's opportunity profile. Use when you need to submit a filled form based on an existing template.

tools.name: Create Form Template
tools.description: Tool to create a profile form template for an account. Use when you need to create a new form template with custom fields.

tools.name: Create Interview
tools.description: Tool to create an interview on an externally-managed panel in Lever. Use when scheduling a new interview for an opportunity on a panel where externallyManaged is true.

tools.name: Create Note
tools.description: Tool to create a note on an opportunity profile or add a threaded comment to an existing note.

tools.name: Create Opportunity
tools.description: Tool to create a new candidate opportunity in Lever. Use when adding a new candidate to the system with automatic email-based deduplication.

tools.name: Create Panel
tools.description: Tool to create a new interview panel for an opportunity. Use when scheduling interviews for a candidate.

tools.name: Create Requisition
tools.description: Tool to create a new requisition in Lever for tracking hiring needs. Use when establishing job requisitions to manage headcount and hiring workflows.

tools.name: Create Requisition Field
tools.description: Tool to create a custom requisition field schema for use across requisitions. Use when establishing requisition field schemas for your account.

tools.name: Create Requisition Field Option
tools.description: Tool to add new options to a dropdown requisition field without replacing existing options. Use when you need to expand dropdown choices for requisition fields.

tools.name: Upload File
tools.description: Tool to upload a file temporarily to Lever for use with posting applications. Use when you need to attach resumes or documents before creating opportunities. Files expire after 24 hours and have a 30MB size limit.

tools.name: Create User
tools.description: Tool to create a new user in the Lever system. Use when adding a new team member with configurable access role.

tools.name: Deactivate User
tools.description: Tool to deactivate a user in the Lever system. Use when you need to prevent a user from logging in while preserving their historical records. Deactivated users remain in the system for historical record keeping but can no longer log in and use Lever.

tools.name: Delete Form Template
tools.description: Tool to delete a profile form template from account. Use when you need to remove a custom API-created form template. System templates cannot be deleted.

tools.name: Delete Interview
tools.description: Tool to delete an interview from an opportunity panel. Use when you need to remove an externally managed interview on behalf of a user. Only interviews with externallyManaged=true can be deleted.

tools.name: Delete Note
tools.description: Tool to delete a note on an opportunity. Use when you need to remove an API-created note.

tools.name: Delete Panel
tools.description: Tool to delete a panel from an opportunity. Use when you need to remove an externally managed panel on behalf of a user. Only panels with externallyManaged=true can be deleted.

tools.name: Delete Profile Form Template
tools.description: Tool to delete a profile form template from account. Use when you need to remove an API-created profile form template. Templates created within the Lever application interface cannot be deleted via API.

tools.name: Delete Requisition
tools.description: Tool to delete or archive a requisition from Lever account. Use when you need to remove a requisition.

tools.name: Delete Requisition Field
tools.description: Tool to delete a requisition field from the account. Use when you need to remove a requisition field that is no longer in use.

tools.name: Delete Requisition Field Option
tools.description: Tool to remove specific options from a dropdown requisition field. Use when you need to delete dropdown choices without removing the entire field.

tools.name: Download File
tools.description: Tool to download a file associated with an opportunity. Use when you have opportunity and file UIDs and need to retrieve the actual file content.

tools.name: Get File Metadata
tools.description: Tool to retrieve metadata for a single file on an opportunity. Use when you have opportunity and file UIDs and need details like name, size, and status before downloading.

tools.name: Get Form
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific profile form for an opportunity. Use when you need to fetch details of a form including field values and completion status.

tools.name: Get Form Template
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single form template by unique identifier. Use when you need to obtain a reference template for creating a new profile form.

tools.name: Get Interview
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single interview for an opportunity. Use when you need to fetch detailed interview information by opportunity and interview UIDs.

tools.name: Get Note
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single note for an opportunity. Use when you need to fetch detailed information for a specific note after confirming the opportunity and note IDs.

tools.name: Get Opportunity
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a single opportunity. Use when you need to fetch comprehensive candidate details including contact information, stage progression, sources, tags, and applications.

tools.name: Get Panel
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single interview panel for an opportunity. Use when you need to fetch detailed panel info by opportunity and panel UIDs.

tools.name: Get Profile Form Template
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single profile form template by unique identifier. Use when you need to obtain a reference profile form template.

tools.name: Get Requisition
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a single requisition by ID. Use when you need to fetch comprehensive requisition details including hiring status, headcount, and associated postings.

tools.name: Get Requisition Field
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a single custom requisition field by ID. Use when you need to fetch the schema and configuration of a specific requisition field.

tools.name: Get Stage
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a single stage by its UUID. Use when you need to fetch stage details from the recruiting pipeline workflow.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a single user by their UUID. Use when you need to fetch complete user profile data including access role, contact links, and organizational details.

tools.name: List Opportunity Files
tools.description: Tool to list all files on an opportunity. Use after obtaining the opportunity UID.

tools.name: List Forms
tools.description: Tool to list all profile forms for an opportunity. Use when you need to retrieve all forms associated with a candidate's profile.

tools.name: List Form Templates
tools.description: Tool to list all active form templates. Use when you need to retrieve all profile form templates for an account.

tools.name: List Interviews
tools.description: Tool to list all interviews for an opportunity. Use when you have an opportunity UID and need to retrieve all its interviews.

tools.name: List Notes
tools.description: Tool to list notes on an opportunity profile. Use when you have an opportunity UID and need to retrieve its notes.

tools.name: List Offers
tools.description: Tool to list offers for an opportunity. Use when you have an opportunity UID and need to retrieve its offers.

tools.name: List Opportunities
tools.description: Tool to list all opportunities in the hiring pipeline. Use when you need to retrieve candidate opportunities with optional filtering by contact, posting, stage, tags, time ranges, or other criteria.

tools.name: List Panels
tools.description: Tool to list all interview panels for an opportunity. Use when you need to retrieve all panels associated with a specific opportunity UID.

tools.name: List Postings
tools.description: Tool to list all job postings including published, internal, closed, draft, pending, and rejected postings. Use when you need to retrieve job postings with optional filtering by state, team, department, location, commitment, level, tag, or update timestamp.

tools.name: List Referrals
tools.description: Tool to list all referrals for an opportunity. Use when you have an opportunity UID and need to retrieve its referrals.

tools.name: List Requisition Fields
tools.description: Tool to list all requisition field schemas in your Lever account with optional filtering. Use when you need to retrieve requisition fields with optional filtering by required status or field type.

tools.name: List Requisitions
tools.description: Tool to list all requisitions with filtering and pagination. Use when you need to retrieve requisitions, optionally filtered by status, code, confidentiality, or creation date.

tools.name: List Opportunity Resumes
tools.description: Tool to list all resumes for an opportunity. Use after obtaining the opportunity UID to retrieve candidate resumes.

tools.name: List Sources
tools.description: Tool to list all recruitment sources in your Lever account. Use when you need to retrieve information about sources (e.g., LinkedIn, Indeed, referrals, career site).

tools.name: List Stages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all pipeline stages in your Lever account. Use when you need to list all hiring stages.

tools.name: List Tags
tools.description: Tool to list all tags in your Lever account. Use when you need to retrieve tags used to categorize candidates, opportunities, and postings.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all active users in your Lever account with optional filters. Use when you need to list users, filter by email, access role, or include deactivated users.

tools.name: Reactivate User
tools.description: Tool to reactivate a previously deactivated user in the Lever system. Use when you need to restore login and Lever access to a user. After reactivation, the user's deactivatedAt field will be set to null, indicating the user is active again.

tools.name: Remove Contact Links by Opportunity
tools.description: Tool to remove links from a contact associated with an opportunity. Useful when invalid or outdated URLs need to be detached from a candidate profile.

tools.name: Remove Opportunity Links
tools.description: Tool to remove links from an opportunity. Use when you need to delete URLs like LinkedIn profiles, GitHub accounts, or other web links from a candidate's contact information.

tools.name: Remove Opportunity Sources
tools.description: Tool to remove sources from an opportunity. Use when you need to delete source attributions from a candidate's recruitment tracking information.

tools.name: Remove Opportunity Tags
tools.description: Tool to remove tags from an opportunity. Use when you need to detach specific labels from an existing opportunity before further updates or archiving.

tools.name: Update Form Template
tools.description: Tool to update an existing profile form template. Use when you need to modify a form template's name, instructions, fields, or other properties.

tools.name: Update Interview
tools.description: Tool to update an interview on an externally-managed panel. Use when modifying all details of an externally-managed panel interview via API.

tools.name: Update Note
tools.description: Tool to update a note on an opportunity profile. Endpoint: PUT /opportunities/{opportunity}/notes/{note} Notes: Only notes originally created via the API can be updated.

tools.name: Update Panel
tools.description: Tool to update an externally-managed panel for an opportunity. Use when modifying panel details such as applications, timezone, interviews, or notes after confirming the panel is externally-managed.

tools.name: Update Requisition
tools.description: Tool to update an existing requisition in Lever. Use when modifying requisition details such as name, headcount, status, or other attributes. This performs a full resource update where all required fields must be provided.

tools.name: Update Requisition Field
tools.description: Tool to update an existing requisition field in Lever. Use when modifying requisition field properties. IMPORTANT: This is an atomic update - include all properties you want to keep, as omitted properties will be deleted.

tools.name: Update Requisition Field Option
tools.description: Tool to update existing options in a dropdown requisition field without replacing the entire field object. Use when you need to modify the text of dropdown choices for requisition fields.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Tool to update an existing user in the Lever system. Use when modifying user information such as name, email, access role, or job details. WARNING: This performs a full resource update - all fields will be overwritten, and missing optional fields will be reset to defaults.

tools.name: Upload File to Opportunity
tools.description: Tool to upload a file permanently to an opportunity. Use when you need to attach resumes, documents, or other files directly to a candidate's opportunity profile. Files have a 30MB size limit.

name: PandaDoc
description: PandaDoc offers document creation, e-signatures, and workflow automation, helping sales teams and businesses streamline proposals, contracts, and agreement processes

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: This tool creates a new contact in PandaDoc. It allows you to add a new contact with their personal and professional information to your PandaDoc account. The tool is completely independent and doesn't require any external resource IDs or dependencies.

tools.name: Create Document Attachment
tools.description: Creates and adds an attachment to a PandaDoc document. This tool allows you to attach downloadable files such as supplemental materials, Excel spreadsheets, or other content without embedding them directly into the document. Attachments can be added only to documents in 'document.draft' status, with a maximum of 10 files per document and a size limit of 50MB per file.

tools.name: Create Document from File Upload
tools.description: Creates a new document in PandaDoc by uploading a file (PDF, DOCX, etc.). This tool converts existing documents into PandaDoc documents for processing, signing, and tracking through the PandaDoc system.

tools.name: Create Document Folder
tools.description: Creates a new folder in PandaDoc to organize documents. This action allows users to create a new folder with a specified name and optionally set a parent folder to create a nested folder structure.

tools.name: Create or Update Contact
tools.description: This tool creates a new contact or updates an existing one in PandaDoc based on the email address. If a contact with the provided email exists, it will be updated; otherwise, a new contact will be created.

tools.name: Create Template
tools.description: This tool allows users to create a new template in PandaDoc from a PDF file or from scratch. It handles file upload validation, parameter checks, proper error handling, and authentication with the PandaDoc API. The template can be created either by uploading a PDF file or by providing a structured content object that defines the template layout and elements.

tools.name: Create PandaDoc Webhook
tools.description: Creates a new webhook subscription in PandaDoc to receive notifications about specific events. This action allows you to set up webhook notifications for various document-related events such as status changes, recipient completions, and updates. The webhook will send HTTP notifications to your specified endpoint when the configured events occur.

tools.name: Delete Contact
tools.description: This tool allows you to delete a contact from your PandaDoc account. The action is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Template
tools.description: This tool deletes a specific template from PandaDoc. Once a template is deleted, it cannot be recovered. This action is permanent and should be used with caution.

tools.name: Get Document Details
tools.description: Fetch detailed metadata for a specific PandaDoc document including recipients, fields/tokens values, pricing data, metadata, tags, and content-block names. Use this after discovering a document via list/search to inspect recipients/status/fields/metadata/content-block references for follow-up automation or reporting.

tools.name: Get Template Details
tools.description: This tool retrieves detailed information about a specific template by its ID. The endpoint returns comprehensive template details including metadata, content details, and sharing settings.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: List all contacts in your PandaDoc workspace. Returns all contacts with their details including email, name, company, and contact information. Optionally filter by exact email address. Note: The API returns all contacts at once without pagination - filtering and pagination should be done client-side if needed.

tools.name: List Document Folders
tools.description: This tool retrieves a list of all document folders in PandaDoc. It's a standalone action that doesn't require any external dependencies or resource IDs. The tool will return a list of folders containing documents, with each folder containing information about its ID, name, and parent folder relationship.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: This tool retrieves a list of all templates available in the PandaDoc account. It supports parameters to filter templates by name, shared status, deleted status, pagination, and tag filtering, and returns detailed template information.

tools.name: Move Document to Folder
tools.description: This tool allows users to move a document to a specific folder within their PandaDoc account. It performs a POST request to move the document to the specified folder. Both the document and the destination folder must exist.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your PandaDoc API key for authentication.

name: Workiom
description: Workiom allows businesses to create custom workflows, integrate apps, and automate processes, reducing manual overhead and streamlining operations

tools.name: Create record
tools.description: Creates a new record in a specified Workiom list. This tool creates a record with basic field types like text, numbers, dates, and static list items. The record data should be provided as a JSON object where each key is a field ID and the value matches the expected data type for that field.

tools.name: Get all lists
tools.description: Get all lists from a Workiom app. This action fetches all lists within a specific Workiom app. Lists are containers for records (similar to database tables) and are the fundamental data structure in Workiom. Each list has a unique ID and contains views for displaying data. Use this action to discover available lists before performing operations like creating records (which require a list ID).

tools.name: Get records
tools.description: Retrieves records from a specified Workiom list. Use this action to fetch data from a Workiom list. The list_id is required and can be obtained from the WORKIOM_GET_ALL_LISTS action. Each record contains field values keyed by numeric field IDs. Features: - Pagination: Use max_result_count and skip_count to paginate through large datasets - Sorting: Sort by any field using 'FIELD_ID ASC' or 'FIELD_ID DESC' format - Filtering: Apply conditions using filter operators (Contains, Is, Greater, etc.) Note: Field IDs are numeric (e.g., 5037173) and can be found in list metadata.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Workiom API key

IMPORTANT - DIMENSION/METRIC COMPATIBILITY: The Google Analytics Data API has strict compatibility rules between dimensions and metrics. Not all combinations are valid. If you receive a 400 error with a message about incompatible dimensions/metrics, use the GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_CHECK_COMPATIBILITY action first to validate your dimension/metric combinations before running reports. Common incompatibilities include: - Demographic dimensions (userAgeBracket, userGender) with session-scoped dimensions/filters (sessionCampaignName, sessionSource) - Certain user-scoped dimensions with event-scoped metrics For complex queries, consider starting with simpler dimension/metric combinations or use CHECK_COMPATIBILITY to pre-validate your request.

tools.name: Get Active Task
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single active (non-completed) task by ID. Use when you need to fetch details of a specific active task.

tools.name: Get All Collaborators
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all collaborators of a shared project. Use when you need to see who has access to a shared Todoist project.

tools.name: Get All Comments
tools.description: This tool retrieves all comments associated with a specific task or project in Todoist. You must provide exactly one of task_id or project_id (they are mutually exclusive - do not provide both). Returns a JSON array of comment objects with details such as id, posted_at, content, and attachment information.

tools.name: Get All Personal Labels
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all personal labels for the authenticated user. Use when you need to see all available labels in the user's account.

tools.name: Get all projects
tools.description: Get all projects from a user's Todoist account. This tool retrieves all projects from the authenticated user's Todoist account. The response includes details like project ID, name, color, parent project, sharing status, and other metadata for each project.

tools.name: Get All Sections
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all the sections for a specific project in Todoist. Use when you need to list section structure within a project after selecting the project.

tools.name: Get All Tasks
tools.description: Fetches all INCOMPLETE tasks from Todoist and returns their details. IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS: - This endpoint only returns active (incomplete) tasks - Cannot retrieve completed tasks - use a different endpoint for that - Filter queries using 'completed', '!completed', or 'completed after' will fail - Project/label references must use ACTUAL EXISTING names from the user's account - Arbitrary text in filters causes 400 errors - use 'search: keyword' for text search Common use cases: - Get all tasks: no filter - Get today's tasks: filter="today" - Get overdue tasks: filter="overdue" - Get tasks from specific project: filter="#ProjectName" (project must exist) - Get high priority tasks: filter="p1" - Search task content: filter="search: keyword"

tools.name: Get Backups
tools.description: Tool to list all available backup archives for the user. Use when you need to retrieve and review all existing backups.

tools.name: Get Comment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific comment by its comment_id. Use when you need full information (content, timestamp, or attachment) about a known comment.

tools.name: Get Comment (V1)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single comment by ID using the v1 API. Use when you need to fetch details of a specific comment.

tools.name: Get Completed Tasks By Completion Date
tools.description: Tool to retrieve completed tasks within a specified completion date window. Use when you need to fetch historical completed tasks for reporting, audits, or weekly summaries. The API restricts the completion-date range to approximately 3 months between since and until parameters.

tools.name: Get ID Mappings
tools.description: Tool to translate IDs between Todoist API v1 and v2. Use when you need to convert IDs between API versions for sections, tasks, comments, reminders, location_reminders, or projects.

tools.name: Get Label
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific label by its ID. Use when you need detailed info about a label after you have its ID.

tools.name: Get Label (v1)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific label by its ID using v1 API. Use when you need detailed info about a label after you have its ID.

tools.name: Get Personal Label
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a personal label by its ID. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific personal label.

tools.name: Get Productivity Stats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve comprehensive productivity statistics for the authenticated user. Use when you need detailed completion data, karma scores, streaks, or goal tracking information for productivity reports and analysis.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific project by its ID. Use when you have a project ID and need its metadata before display or update.

tools.name: Get Project (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific project by its ID using Todoist API v1. Use when you need detailed project information including workspace-specific fields.

tools.name: Get Project Collaborators
tools.description: Tool to get all collaborators of a shared project. Use when you need to retrieve the list of people who have access to a specific shared project.

tools.name: Get Full Project Data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve full project data including all sections, tasks, and collaborators. Use when you need comprehensive project information beyond basic metadata.

tools.name: Get Project Permissions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available roles and their associated actions in Todoist projects. Use when you need to understand what permissions different roles have in projects.

tools.name: Get Section
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific section by its ID. Use when you have a section ID and need its metadata before display or update.

tools.name: Get Section (v1 API)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific section by its ID using Todoist v1 API. Use when you need section metadata from the v1 endpoint.

tools.name: Get Shared Labels
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all shared labels across the user's workspace. Use when you need to see labels that are shared within the workspace.

tools.name: Get Single Section
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single section as a JSON object by its ID. Use when you have a section ID and need to fetch its details.

tools.name: Get Special Backups
tools.description: Tool to list special backup archives for the user. Use when you need to retrieve all project backups for the authenticated user after creating or managing projects.

tools.name: Get Sync Data
tools.description: Tool to read sync data from the Todoist server. Use when you need to fetch user data including projects, tasks, labels, and other resources using the Sync API.

tools.name: Get Task
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific task by its ID. Use when you need to fetch all details of an existing task before processing or display.

tools.name: Get Task (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single active (non-completed) task by ID using API v1. Use when you need to fetch task details from the v1 endpoint.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the currently authenticated user. Use when you need user details like email, name, preferences, karma, or subscription status.

tools.name: Import Template Into Project By ID
tools.description: Tool to import a template from Todoist's template gallery into an existing project. Use when you need to add structured tasks and sections from a pre-made template to an existing project.

tools.name: Import Template Into Project From File
tools.description: Tool to import a CSV template into an existing Todoist project from a file. Use when you need to bulk-create tasks, sections, and notes from a template file.

tools.name: List Activities
tools.description: Tool to get activity logs from Todoist. Returns a paginated list of activity events for the user. Events can be filtered by object type (project, item, note), event type, and other criteria. Uses cursor-based pagination for efficient navigation through results.

tools.name: List Archived Projects
tools.description: Tool to get all archived projects from Todoist. Use when you need to retrieve archived projects with pagination support.

tools.name: List Archived Sections
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all archived sections for a specific project in Todoist. Use when you need to access sections that have been archived in a project.

tools.name: List Archived Workspace Projects
tools.description: Tool to list all archived projects in a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve archived workspace projects with optional filters or pagination.

tools.name: List Comments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all comments for a given task or project using cursor-based pagination. Use when you need to fetch comments from Todoist tasks or projects. Exactly one of task_id or project_id must be provided.

tools.name: List Completed Tasks By Due Date
tools.description: Tool to retrieve completed tasks within a specified due date range (up to 6 weeks). Use when you need to fetch completed tasks filtered by their original due dates rather than completion dates.

tools.name: List Filters
tools.description: Tool to list all filters for the authenticated user. Use when you need to retrieve the current set of custom filters.

tools.name: List Joinable Workspaces
tools.description: Tool to get workspaces the user can join. Use when you need to discover available workspaces that the authenticated user can join.

tools.name: List Labels
tools.description: Tool to get all user labels with pagination support. Use when you need to retrieve labels from the user's Todoist account.

tools.name: List Pending Workspace Invitations
tools.description: Tool to list pending invitation emails in a workspace. Use when you need to check which email invites are still pending acceptance in a workspace.

tools.name: List Project Collaborators
tools.description: Tool to get all collaborators for a given project with cursor-based pagination. Use when you need to retrieve the list of people who have access to a specific project.

tools.name: List Sections
tools.description: Tool to get all active sections for the user, with optional filtering by project. Supports cursor-based pagination to handle large result sets.

tools.name: List Shared Labels
tools.description: Tool to retrieve shared label names from active tasks with pagination support. Use when you need to list labels across the workspace with optional filtering of personal labels.

tools.name: List Workspace Active Projects
tools.description: Tool to list all active workspace projects. Returns active projects that are visible to the user, including those not yet joined. For guest users, only joined workspace projects are returned.

tools.name: List Workspace Archived Projects
tools.description: Tool to get archived projects in a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve a list of archived projects for a specific workspace with optional pagination.

tools.name: List Workspace Users
tools.description: Tool to list users in workspace(s). Use when you need to retrieve workspace members. Returns users from a specific workspace if workspace_id is provided, otherwise returns users from all workspaces the authenticated user is part of. Not accessible by guests.

tools.name: Move Task
tools.description: Tool to move a task to another project, section, or parent task while preserving task identity and metadata. Use when you need to relocate a task without recreating it.

tools.name: Move Task (REST API)
tools.description: Tool to move a task to another project, section, or parent task using the REST API. Use when you need to relocate a task while preserving its identity and metadata.

tools.name: Quick Add Task
tools.description: Tool to add tasks using natural language parsing similar to the official Todoist clients. Use when you want to create a task quickly with natural language that includes dates, projects, labels, priority, and other task attributes in a single text string.

tools.name: Remove Shared Labels
tools.description: Tool to remove all instances of a shared label from tasks. Use when you need to remove a shared label created by a collaborator from your account.

tools.name: Remove Shared Label (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to remove a shared label from all active tasks using API v1. Use when you need to remove a shared label created by a collaborator from your account.

tools.name: Rename Shared Labels
tools.description: Tool to rename a shared label across the workspace. Use when you need to change the name of a shared label created by a collaborator.

tools.name: Rename Shared Labels (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to rename a shared label across all active tasks using API v1. Use when you need to change the name of a shared label.

tools.name: Reopen Task
tools.description: Tool to reopen a completed task in Todoist. Use when you need to restore a previously completed task and its ancestors.

tools.name: Reopen Task (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to reopen a completed task in Todoist using API v1. Use when you need to restore a previously completed task. Any ancestor tasks or sections will also be marked as uncomplete and restored from history.

tools.name: Reorder Tasks
tools.description: Reorder tasks deterministically by updating child_order in bulk via the Sync API item_reorder command. Use when you need to set specific ordering for tasks.

tools.name: Search Labels
tools.description: Tool to search user labels by name with case-insensitive matching. Use when you need to find specific labels by name pattern.

tools.name: Search Projects
tools.description: Search active user projects by name with support for wildcards and pagination. Use when you need to find projects matching a specific name pattern.

tools.name: Search Sections
tools.description: Tool to search active sections by name, optionally filtered by project. Use when you need to find sections matching a specific name pattern across all projects or within a specific project. Supports pagination for large result sets.

tools.name: Todoist Sync
tools.description: Tool to sync data with Todoist server, supporting both read and write operations. This is the central endpoint used by Todoist apps for all data synchronization. Use this action to: - Read multiple resource types in a single request (projects, tasks, labels, etc.) - Perform batch write operations (create/update/delete up to 100 resources at once) - Implement efficient incremental sync using sync tokens - Execute complex multi-step operations in a single atomic request For read-only operations, pass sync_token and resource_types. For write operations, include commands array with the operations to execute. Commands support batching up to 100 operations per request.

tools.name: Unarchive Project
tools.description: Tool to unarchive a Todoist project. Use when you need to reactivate an archived project for the user (personal projects) or all workspace users (workspace projects).

tools.name: Unarchive Project (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to unarchive a previously archived Todoist project using API v1. Use when you need to reactivate an archived project, making it visible again for the initiating user (personal projects) or all workspace users (workspace projects).

tools.name: Update Comment
tools.description: Tool to update a specific comment's content. Use when you need to correct or clarify an existing comment after confirming its ID and the new text.

tools.name: Update Comment (v1)
tools.description: Tool to update a comment by ID and return its content via v1 API. Use when you need to modify an existing comment's text using the v1 API endpoint.

tools.name: Update Label
tools.description: Tool to update a personal label's properties. Use when you need to modify a label's name, color, order, or favorite status.

tools.name: Update Label (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to update an existing label using API v1. Use when you need to modify a label's name, color, order, or favorite status.

tools.name: Update Notification Setting
tools.description: Tool to update notification settings for the current user. Use when you need to enable or disable notifications for specific event types and channels.

tools.name: Update Personal Label
tools.description: Tool to update an existing personal label's properties. Use when you need to modify a label's name, color, order, or favorite status.

tools.name: Update Project
tools.description: Tool to update a project's properties including name, color, favorite status, and view style. Use when you need to modify project settings after reviewing its current configuration.

tools.name: Update Project (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to update a project's properties using Todoist API v1. Use when you need to modify project settings like name, description, favorite status, color, or view style.

tools.name: Update Section
tools.description: Tool to update a specific section's name. Use when you need to rename a section after confirming its ID.

tools.name: Update Section (v1)
tools.description: Tool to update an existing section by its ID using Todoist v1 API. Use when you need to rename a section.

tools.name: Update Task
tools.description: Tool to update an existing task's properties. Use when you need to modify a task's details after confirming its ID and new values.

tools.name: Update Task (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to update an existing task's properties using Todoist API v1. Use when you need to modify task details after confirming the task ID and new values.

tools.name: Update Workspace Logo
tools.description: Tool to upload an image as the workspace logo or delete the existing logo. Use when you need to set or remove a workspace's branding image.

tools.name: Upload File
tools.description: Tool to upload a file to Todoist. Use when you need to attach files to tasks or projects. The uploaded file can be later attached to comments or tasks using the returned file_url.
