description: VirusTotal is a free online service that analyzes files and URLs for viruses, worms, trojans, and other kinds of malicious content using multiple antivirus engines and website scanners.

tools.name: Add VirusTotal Comment
tools.description: Tool to add a comment to a VirusTotal resource (file, URL, domain, or IP address). Use after analyzing a resource to leave contextual feedback. Provide exactly one identifier per call.

tools.name: Add Vote
tools.description: Tool to add a vote (harmless/malicious) to a VirusTotal resource. Use after reviewing analysis results to submit your verdict.

tools.name: Get Analysis Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the analysis report of a file or URL submission. Use after obtaining an analysis ID to fetch its detailed report.

tools.name: Get comments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the latest comments on a VirusTotal resource. Use when you need to review user-generated comments for a file, URL, domain, or IP after obtaining its identifier.

tools.name: Get Domain Relationships
tools.description: Tool to retrieve relationship objects for a given domain. Use when you have a domain and need to explore its related entities.

tools.name: Get Domain Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the analysis report of a domain. Use when you need detailed insight on a domain's reputation and analysis stats.

tools.name: Get File Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the analysis report of a file. Use when you have a file's hash and need detailed scan metadata.

tools.name: Get IP Address Relationships
tools.description: Tool to retrieve objects related to a specific IP address by relationship type. Use when you have an IP and need to explore connected files, URLs, or other entities.

tools.name: Get IP Address Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the analysis report of an IP address. Use when you need detailed insight on an IP's reputation, ASN, country, and analysis stats.

tools.name: Get VirusTotal Metadata
tools.description: Tool to retrieve VirusTotal metadata. Use when you need information about available privileges, relationships between resources (like files, domains, IPs, URLs), and supported antivirus engines.

tools.name: Get URL Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the analysis report of a URL. Use when you have a URL identifier (base64-url without padding) and need detailed scan results, reputation, and metadata.

tools.name: Get Votes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve votes on files, URLs, domains, or IP addresses. Use when you need to view community votes for a given object.

tools.name: Rescan File
tools.description: Tool to re-analyze a previously submitted file. Use when you need updated analysis results after an initial scan.

tools.name: Scan URL
tools.description: Tool to submit a URL for scanning. Use when you have a URL and need to submit it to VirusTotal to obtain an analysis ID for later retrieval.

tools.name: Search VirusTotal
tools.description: Tool to search for objects in the VirusTotal database. Use when locating files, URLs, domains, IPs, or comments matching a query. Supports pagination with limit and cursor.

tools.name: Upload File
tools.description: Tool to upload a file for scanning. Use when you have binary file content ready to submit for VirusTotal analysis.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your personal VirusTotal API key, found in your VirusTotal account settings.

name: Wachete
description: Wachete is a web monitoring service that allows users to track changes on web pages and receive notifications based on specified criteria.

tools.name: Create Watcher
tools.description: Create or update a Wachete watcher to monitor web page changes. Watchers check pages at specified intervals and send alerts when changes are detected. Use SinglePage mode for monitoring a single page, or Portal mode to crawl and monitor multiple linked pages.

tools.name: Delete watcher
tools.description: Deletes a website monitoring watcher (task) by its unique ID. This operation is idempotent - deleting a non-existent or already-deleted watcher will succeed without error. Use when you need to permanently remove a monitoring task. Obtain the watcher ID from List Watchers or Create Watcher actions before calling. Example: "Delete the watcher with ID 974b65b5-6ccb-4996-812c-5a678c2455e8"

tools.name: Get folder content
tools.description: Retrieves the contents of a Wachete folder, including subfolders and watcher tasks. Use this tool to: - List all subfolders and tasks in the root folder (omit parentId) - List contents of a specific folder (provide parentId) - Navigate the folder hierarchy using the path breadcrumb - Check task statuses and last check data Returns subfolders, tasks with their monitoring details, folder path, and pagination token.

tools.name: List notifications
tools.description: Retrieves notifications from Wachete watchers. Returns notifications for all watchers or filtered by specific watcher ID and/or time range. Useful for checking recent changes detected by your web page monitors.

tools.name: List watchers
tools.description: List all monitoring watchers (tasks) configured in your Wachete account. Optionally filter by search query. Returns up to 500 watchers with details including name, URL, monitoring settings, and notification configuration.

required.name: generic_token
required.description: Your authentication token. Get this by POSTing your User ID and API Key to https://api.wachete.com/thirdparty/v1/user/apilogin (see API docs for details)

name: Waiverfile
description: WaiverFile is an electronic waiver form system that allows customers to sign release waivers from any device, streamlining the waiver management process.

tools.name: Get Site Details
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive configuration and metadata for a WaiverFile site. Returns site settings including name, welcome messages, field requirements, email configuration, age restrictions, and other site-specific configuration data. Use this to understand site setup and display site information.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key provided by WaiverFile for authenticating API requests.

required.name: generic_id
required.description: The unique identifier for your WaiverFile site.

name: Wati
description: Wati is a WhatsApp Business API platform that automates marketing, sales, service, and support.

tools.name: Add Contact
tools.description: Tool to add a new contact in WATI. Use when registering a customer's WhatsApp number before sending messages.

tools.name: Get Teams
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of teams from WATI. Use after authenticating when you need to enumerate all available teams.

tools.name: Send Session Message
tools.description: Tool to send a session message to a specified WhatsApp number. Use when you need to deliver a free-form text within an active 24-hour session window.

tools.name: Wati update chat status
tools.description: Update the status of a chat/conversation in WATI Team Inbox. This action allows you to change the status of a customer's chat to help manage ongoing conversations. Available statuses: - OPEN: Active, two-way conversation - PENDING: Waiting for customer's response - SOLVED: Issue has been resolved - BLOCK: Prevent further communication with the contact

tools.name: Update Contact Attributes
tools.description: Tool to update attributes of an existing contact. Use after confirming the contact exists and you need to modify its custom attributes.

required.name: full
required.description: The base URL for the Wati API. For paid plans, use this: https://live-mt-server.wati.io and must provide your tenant ID.

required.name: bearer_token
required.description: The access token required for authenticating API requests. You can obtain it from the Wati UI under the 'API Docs' section. Note: Changing your Wati account password will invalidate the current access token.

optional.name: tenant_id
optional.description: The tenant ID (Client ID) for Wati paid accounts. This is generated when you register for a paid MT account and is used to log in. You can find it in the Wati URL when logged in or in your profile under "Client ID".

name: Webscraper io
description: WebScraper.IO is a web scraping tool that makes web data extraction easy and accessible for everyone through a cloud-based API.

tools.name: Create Sitemap
tools.description: Tool to create a new sitemap configuration for web scraping. Use when you need to define a new scraping structure with start URLs and selector rules for data extraction from a website.

tools.name: Delete Sitemap
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a sitemap configuration from Web Scraper Cloud account. Use when you need to remove a sitemap that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Disable Sitemap Scheduler
tools.description: Tool to disable automatic scheduling for a sitemap. Use when you need to stop automated scraping jobs from running on a schedule.

tools.name: Enable Sitemap Scheduler
tools.description: Tool to enable and configure automatic scheduling for sitemap scraping jobs. Use when you need to automate scraping jobs to run at specific times using cron expressions with customizable request intervals, page load delays, driver types, and proxy settings.

tools.name: Get Account Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve account information including email and page credits. Use when you need to check account details or available credits.

tools.name: Get Scraping Jobs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all scraping jobs for the account with optional filtering and pagination. Use when you need to list scraping jobs, check job status, or filter jobs by sitemap or tag.

tools.name: Get Sitemap
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific sitemap configuration by ID. Use when you need to inspect or reference an existing sitemap's configuration.

tools.name: Get Sitemaps
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all sitemaps for the authenticated account with pagination support. Use when you need to list available sitemaps or filter them by tag. Supports optional pagination via page parameter and filtering by tag name.

tools.name: Get Sitemap Scheduler
tools.description: Tool to retrieve scheduler configuration for a sitemap. Use when you need to check scheduling settings including cron configuration and proxy settings.

tools.name: Update Sitemap
tools.description: Tool to update an existing sitemap configuration including structure, URLs, and selectors. Use when you need to modify sitemap settings.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your WebScraper.IO API token. Get it from Account Info > API settings in your Web Scraper Cloud dashboard.

name: WebScraping.AI
description: WebScraping.AI provides an API for web scraping with features like Chrome JS rendering, rotating proxies, and HTML parsing.

tools.name: Get account usage and quota
tools.description: Tool to retrieve account API call quota and usage. Use when checking remaining requests and subscription details.

tools.name: Retrieve HTML Content
tools.description: Tool to retrieve HTML content of a web page. Use when you need raw page HTML, optionally rendered with JavaScript.

tools.name: Get Rendered HTML
tools.description: Tool to retrieve fully rendered HTML of a webpage. Use when JS-generated content must be included.

tools.name: Get Text
tools.description: Tool to retrieve raw text content from a specified web page. Use when you need plain text extraction from a URL.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your WebScraping.AI API key for query parameter authentication

name: Webvizio
description: Webvizio is a visual feedback and collaboration tool for web professionals, enabling users to annotate web pages, share feedback, track bugs, and manage tasks efficiently.

tools.name: List webhook subscriptions
tools.description: Tool to list all configured outgoing webhook subscriptions. Use when you need an overview of active webhooks before managing them.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your personal access token for Webvizio API requests. You can generate this token in your Webvizio account settings.

name: Whautomate
description: Whautomate is a platform that offers seamless integrations for customer engagement, including AI chatbots, appointment scheduling, and broadcast messaging.

tools.name: Add Contact
tools.description: Tool to add a new contact. Use when you need to programmatically create contacts via the API.

tools.name: Delete Segment
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific segment. Use when you need to remove a segment by its ID. Use after confirming you have the correct segmentId.

tools.name: Delete Service Category
tools.description: Tool to delete a service category. Use when you need to remove a specific service category by its ID. Use after confirming you have the correct serviceCategoryId.

tools.name: Get All Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all registered webhooks. Use after authenticating to audit or inspect existing webhook subscriptions.

tools.name: Get Broadcast By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific broadcast's details. Use when you have a broadcast ID and need its metadata. Use after confirming the broadcastId is valid, as this returns detailed broadcast data.

tools.name: Get Broadcasts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of broadcasts. Use when you need to fetch broadcasts with optional filters such as status or date ranges. Example: "Get all scheduled broadcasts after 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z."

tools.name: Get Contacts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of contacts. Use when you need to fetch contacts from WhatsApp with optional pagination and filters.

tools.name: Get Messages of Contact
tools.description: Tool to retrieve chat messages for a specific contact. Use after providing a valid contactId. Supports pagination and optional date filtering.

tools.name: Get Segments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of segments. Use when you need to fetch segments with optional name filtering and pagination. Segments can be used to organize clients and contacts into groups based on various criteria.

tools.name: Get Service By Id
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific service by its unique ID. Use when you need comprehensive service information.

tools.name: Get Service Categories
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of service categories. Use when you need to list categories with optional pagination.

tools.name: Get Services
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of services with optional filters. Use when you need to fetch available services for display or scheduling.

tools.name: Get Staff Availability Blocks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a staff member's blocked time schedule over a date range. Use when you need to view unavailable slots after confirming staffId and desired date range.

tools.name: Get Staff By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific staff member. Use when you have a valid staff ID and need full profile details. Use after confirming staffId.

tools.name: Get Staffs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of staff members. Use when you need to list staff with optional pagination or search filters.

tools.name: Update Service
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Whautomate service. Use when you need to modify service attributes like name, pricing, duration, or active status.

required.name: full
required.description: The API host URL based on your geographical location. For example, 'https://api.whautomate.com' for global access or 'https://api.in.whautomate.com' for India.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key generated from your Whautomate account. This API key is required and must be included in the "x-api-key" header for all API requests.

name: Whoisfreaks
description: Best Source For Domain WHOIS Database and API.

tools.name: ASN WHOIS Lookup
tools.description: Tool to retrieve comprehensive ASN WHOIS information including ownership, network infrastructure, and IP address ranges. Use when you need to identify ASN ownership, organization details, or associated IP blocks for network administration or security analysis.

tools.name: Bulk DNS Lookup
tools.description: Tool to process multiple domains or IPs simultaneously, returning all DNS records in a single request (max 100). Use when you need to retrieve DNS records for multiple domains at once for efficient batch processing.

tools.name: Bulk Domain Availability Check
tools.description: Tool to check availability of multiple domains in one request (max 100 domains). Use when you need to verify if domain names are available for registration. Response time ranges from 16 seconds to 1 minute for 100 domains.

tools.name: Bulk WHOIS Lookup
tools.description: Tool to query WHOIS information for up to 100 domains in a single request. Use when you need comprehensive registration details, contact information, name servers, and domain status for multiple domains. Response includes normalized and parsed WHOIS data with 1 credit charged per successful query for each domain.

tools.name: DNS Live Lookup
tools.description: Tool to perform real-time DNS record resolution for network diagnostics and configuration verification. Use when you need to retrieve current DNS records for a domain or perform reverse DNS lookup for an IP address.

tools.name: Check Domain Availability
tools.description: Tool to check if a domain is available for registration with optional suggestions. Use when you need to verify domain availability or get alternative domain suggestions.

tools.name: Get Domain Files Status
tools.description: Tool to check availability and update status of domain data files including newly registered, expired, and dropped domains. Use when you need to verify that domain data files are prepared and ready for download before accessing file download endpoints.

tools.name: IP Geolocation Lookup
tools.description: Tool to retrieve geographic location information for an IP address including country, city, coordinates, ISP, and security details. Use when you need to identify the physical location of an IP, detect VPN/proxy usage, or gather network intelligence for security or analytics purposes.

tools.name: IP WHOIS Lookup
tools.description: Tool to retrieve comprehensive WHOIS information for an IP address including organization, ISP, and network details. Use when you need to identify IP ownership, allocation status, or contact information for network administration or security purposes.

tools.name: Security Threat Lookup
tools.description: Tool to check if an IP address is associated with malicious activity, security threats, or appears on blocklists. Use when you need to assess IP reputation, detect VPN/proxy/Tor usage, identify bots or spam sources, or evaluate security risk for access control and fraud prevention.

tools.name: SSL Certificate Lookup
tools.description: Tool to fetch live SSL certificate with full secure cert chain, validity dates, and issuer information. Use when you need to retrieve SSL certificate details for a domain, including certificate validation dates, issuer details, public key information, and certificate extensions.

tools.name: Subdomain Lookup
tools.description: Tool to discover all subdomains associated with a domain name. Use when you need to enumerate subdomains for security assessment, asset discovery, or domain reconnaissance. Supports filtering by active/inactive status and date ranges.

tools.name: WHOIS Historical Lookup
tools.description: Tool to access historical domain records from comprehensive database with up to 100 records per page. Use when you need to retrieve historical WHOIS data for a domain dating back to 1986. Database is updated monthly with one-month data latency.

tools.name: WHOIS Live Lookup
tools.description: Tool to fetch real-time WHOIS domain registration data directly from authoritative WHOIS servers. Use when you need current domain ownership, registration dates, contact information, or nameserver details. Note that some fields may show 'REDACTED FOR PRIVACY' due to ICANN privacy regulations.

tools.name: WHOIS Live Lookup V2
tools.description: Tool to fetch real-time WHOIS domain data using v2.0 endpoint. Use when you need current domain ownership, registration dates, contact information, or nameserver details via the updated v2.0 API. Note that some fields may show 'REDACTED FOR PRIVACY' due to ICANN privacy regulations.

tools.name: WHOIS Reverse Lookup By Company
tools.description: Tool to search for domains registered by a specific company or organization using reverse WHOIS lookup. Use when you need to find all domains associated with a particular company name. Performs full-text phrase matching with pagination support. Charges 5 credits per page retrieved.

tools.name: WHOIS Reverse Lookup by Email
tools.description: Tool to search for domains registered with a specific email address. Use when you need to find all domains associated with an email in WHOIS records. Supports exact or regex email matching. Returns paginated results with domain registration details.

tools.name: WHOIS Reverse Lookup By Owner
tools.description: Tool to search for domains registered by a specific owner name using reverse WHOIS lookup. Use when you need to find all domains associated with a particular registrant or owner name. Performs pattern-based full-text search with pagination support.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in and copy your API key directly from your dashboard at https://billing.whoisfreaks.com/

name: Winston AI
description: Winston AI provides a comprehensive content verification and management platform, offering tools for AI-generated text detection, plagiarism detection, and AI image detection.

tools.name: AI Text Detection
tools.description: Tool to detect AI-generated text. Use when you need to assess whether a given text is AI-generated.

tools.name: Plagiarism Detection
tools.description: Tool to detect plagiarism. Use after preparing text to verify originality against online sources.

tools.name: TEXT_COMPARE
tools.description: Tool to compare two texts. Use when you need to measure similarity between two final texts.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key used for authenticating requests to Winston AI's API.

name: Wisepops
description: WisePops helps you design smart pop-ups for your website to increase sign-ups and conversions

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Tool to create a webhook to receive real-time data updates when forms are collected in Wisepops. Use when you need to set up automated data synchronization for sign-up, phone, or survey form submissions. Note: Wisepops includes an X-Wisepops-Signature header for verification.

tools.name: Delete User Data for Privacy Compliance
tools.description: Tool to automatically delete and suppress data about end-users for GDPR and CCPA compliance. Use when you need to remove user data from the system. Requires at least one identifier (email or phone). When both are supplied, records matching either field are deleted.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Tool to delete an existing webhook by its hook_id. Use when you need to remove a webhook that is no longer needed or should be deactivated.

tools.name: Get Wisepops Performance Data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of your Wisepops with display and conversion metrics. Use when you need to analyze pop-up performance data including display counts, clicks, and email collections.

tools.name: Retrieve Collected Contacts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve contacts collected through Wisepops opt-in forms. Use when you need to fetch contact information with their custom fields and metadata.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Log into your WisePops account, click Profile menu (top right) → Settings → Email API. Note: Each API key is website-specific.

name: Wit.ai
description: Wit.ai is a natural language processing platform that enables developers to build applications and devices that understand human language.

tools.name: Create Wit.ai App
tools.description: Tool to create a new app in Wit.ai. Use when you need to programmatically initialize an application before training or importing data.

tools.name: Create Wit.ai Trait
tools.description: Tool to create a new trait in Wit.ai. Use when defining custom entity attribute matching behavior.

tools.name: Delete App
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific app from wit.ai. Use when you need to remove an existing app by its ID after confirming its existence.

tools.name: Get App Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve metadata and settings of a Wit.ai app. Use when you need to fetch complete app details by app ID after authenticating.

tools.name: Get Intent Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific intent. Use when you need full intent metadata given its ID.

tools.name: Get Intents
tools.description: Tool to list all intents in a Wit.ai app. Use after authenticating to retrieve defined intents.

tools.name: Wit.ai Get Message
tools.description: Tool to analyze a text message and extract its intent, entities, and traits. Use when you need structured meaning from user input.

tools.name: Get Trait Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific trait. Use when you have the trait ID and need its full metadata.

tools.name: List Traits
tools.description: Tool to list all traits in a Wit.ai app. Use after authenticating to retrieve defined traits.

tools.name: Update Wit.ai App
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Wit.ai app. Use when you need to modify app settings after creation.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The Server Access Token for authenticating API requests to Wit.ai.

name: Wix
description: Wix is a cloud-based web development platform that allows users to create HTML5 websites and mobile sites through drag-and-drop tools. The Wix API provides programmatic access to manage sites, products, orders, and other resources.

tools.name: Cancel Automation Event
tools.description: Tool to cancel any remaining automation actions for a trigger and external entity. Use when you need to stop automation workflows that are no longer relevant (e.g., after an invoice is paid or a form submission is processed).

tools.name: Check Domain Availability
tools.description: Tool to check if a domain name is available for purchase. Use when you need to verify domain availability before registration. Returns an availability object with a boolean indicating if the domain can be purchased.

tools.name: Add Labels to Contact
tools.description: Tool to add labels to a Wix contact using the Labels API. Use when you need to categorize or tag contacts with specific labels like 'contacts.customers' or 'contacts.contacted-me'.

tools.name: Enable Points Expiration
tools.description: Tool to enable points expiration for a Wix loyalty program. Use when you need to activate the points expiration feature, which changes the pointsExpiration status to ENABLED.

tools.name: Bulk Create Products With Inventory
tools.description: Tool to bulk create products with inventory in Wix. Use when you need to create multiple products with pricing and stock information in a single request. Supports up to 100 products per request. Physical products require physical_properties.

tools.name: Unlabel Contact
tools.description: Tool to remove labels from a contact in the Wix CRM system. Use when you need to unlabel a contact by removing specific label keys. This triggers a Contact Updated event in the Wix system.

tools.name: Generate Files Download URL
tools.description: Tool to generate download URLs for files in Wix Media Manager. Use when you need to create a permanent download URL for one or multiple files (up to 1000). Returns a download URL for a compressed file containing all requested files.

tools.name: Generate File Upload URL
tools.description: Tool to generate an upload URL for uploading files to Wix Media Manager. Use when you need to upload a file to Wix. Note: Files are not immediately available after upload and require processing time. For files larger than 10MB or poor network conditions, use Generate File Resumable Upload URL instead.

tools.name: Get Collection By Slug
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a Wix Stores collection by its slug. Use when you need to fetch collection details using the collection's URL-friendly identifier instead of its ID.

tools.name: Get Member
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a member by ID from Wix Members. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a specific member. Note: Private members (default privacy status) are not returned for site visitor or member calls.

tools.name: Get Site Plugins Placement Status
tools.description: Tool to get the placement status of your app's site plugins on the user's site. Use when you need to check whether your plugins are currently placed in slots on the user's site.

tools.name: Get Site Properties
tools.description: Tool to retrieve current snapshot of a site's properties including business profile, contact information, and business schedule. Use when you need to fetch site-level business information, contact details, or operating hours.

tools.name: Import File to Media Manager
tools.description: Tool to import a file to Wix Media Manager using an external URL. Use when you need to add a file from an external source to the Media Manager. Note: imported files take time to process and are not immediately available (state=PENDING initially).

tools.name: List Email Marketing Campaigns
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of email marketing campaigns, ordered by date_updated in descending order. Use when you need to get campaigns from Wix Email Marketing with optional filtering by status, visibility, or distribution status.

tools.name: List Contacts Facets
tools.description: Tool to list facets from the site's Contact List. Facets include labels, subscription statuses (email and SMS), and membership statuses. Use when you need to retrieve available contact categorization options with their counts.

tools.name: List Invoices by Order IDs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve invoice IDs and external app IDs for multiple orders. Use when you need to get invoice information associated with one or more Wix eCommerce orders.

tools.name: List V4 Contacts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of up to 1,000 contacts per request from Wix. Use when you need to fetch contact information with support for pagination and field filtering.

tools.name: Query Contacts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve up to 1,000 Wix contacts with advanced filtering, sorting, and pagination. Use when you need to search for specific contacts or retrieve contacts with custom field selections.

tools.name: Query Coupons
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of up to 100 coupons with optional paging, filtering, and sorting. Use when you need to fetch coupons from a Wix store.

tools.name: Query E-Commerce Orders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve e-commerce orders with advanced filtering, sorting, and pagination. Use when you need to search for specific orders or retrieve order lists. Default behavior excludes orders with status 'INITIALIZED'.

tools.name: Query Contact Facets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve facets from the site's contact list by filter. Facets include labels and subscription statuses with aggregated contact counts. Use when you need to get contact segmentation data.

tools.name: Query Form Submissions by Namespace
tools.description: Tool to retrieve form submissions from a specified namespace with optional pagination. Use when you need to query form submissions from Wix Forms or other form apps. The namespace filter is required.

tools.name: Query Inventory Items
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of up to 1000 inventory items with optional paging, filtering, and sorting. Manages inventory per variant including stock quantities, availability status, and preorder information. Use when you need to fetch inventory data from a Wix Stores Catalog V3 site.

tools.name: Query Members Contacts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve up to 1,000 Wix contacts with filtering, sorting, and pagination. Use when you need to search for specific contacts or retrieve contacts with custom field selections.

tools.name: Search Products
tools.description: Tool to search products in the Wix store catalog using text search, filters, and sorting. Returns up to 100 products per request with cursor-based pagination. Use when you need to find specific products or retrieve products matching certain criteria.

tools.name: Update Business Contact
tools.description: Tool to update a site's business contact information including email, phone, fax, and address. Use when you need to modify the public business contact details displayed on a Wix site. Requires Manage Business Contact permission scope.

tools.name: Update Business Profile
tools.description: Tool to update a site's business profile including display name, description, logo, and business name. Use when you need to modify public business information. Only fields specified in the fields.paths array are updated.

tools.name: Update Business Schedule
tools.description: Tool to update a site's business schedule including regular operating hours and special exceptions. Use when you need to set or modify business hours, add holiday closures, or define special event hours. The update replaces the entire schedule, so include all desired periods in each request.

tools.name: Update inventory variants
tools.description: Tool to update product inventory including quantity, stock status, and tracking settings per variant. Use when you need to modify inventory levels or stock configuration. The revision field must match the current value to prevent conflicts.

tools.name: Update Question Entry Labels
tools.description: Tool to set labels for a Wix FAQ question entry. Use when a question entry is updated and you need to modify its labels. This operation replaces all existing labels with the provided list.

tools.name: Bulk Update Order Tags
tools.description: Tool to synchronously update tags on multiple orders by list of order IDs. Use when you need to add or remove tags from multiple orders at once. If a tag appears in both assignTags and unassignTags, it will be assigned.

tools.name: Update Review Moderation Status
tools.description: Tool to update the moderation status of a review. Use when you need to approve, reject, or change the moderation status of a specific review.

tools.name: Bulk Update Review Moderation Status
tools.description: Tool to bulk update the moderation status of multiple reviews at once. All filtered reviews are updated to the same moderation status. Use when you need to moderate multiple reviews efficiently instead of updating them one by one.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

tools.name: Browsewixrestdocsmenu
tools.description:

Alternative to SearchWixRESTDocumentation - use this to explore and discover APIs by navigating the menu structure instead of searching by keywords.

- Pass a `menuUrl` param to drill into a category - copy the URL from previous responses

- CMS: "https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms"

tools.name: Callwixsiteapi
tools.description:
Call Wix apis on a business or site. Use this to create, read, update, and delete data and other Wix entities in your Wix site,
The API endpoint url param MUST ALWAYS be taken from the conversation context.
By conversation context we mean the endpoint url was given in the user prompt OR got into the conversation context by the "WixREADME" tool OR by the "SearchWixRESTDocumentation" tool OR by the "BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu" tool OR by the "ReadFullDocsArticle" tool.
Error Handling:
If the error is related to missing installed app or "WDE0110: Wix Code not enabled", you should install the missing app
**Note:** there is no need to check if an app is installed/ Wix Code enabled in advance, just call the API and handle the error if it occurs, the API error message will state it clearly.
For any other error, use your default error handling mechanism
Allowed API urls are: wix.com, dev.wix.com, manage.wix.com, editor.wix.com, wixapis.com
Docs urls like https://dev.wix.com/docs/... are not api urls, if you want to read the docs, use the "ReadFullDocsArticle" tool

tools.name: Createwixbusinessguide
tools.description:
Provides comprehensive documentation for creating a new Wix Business (i.e site, app, etc.)

## When to Use This Tool

Use this tool when the user requests to create a new Wix site.

## What This Tool Contains

This tool provides complete documentation including:
- Template selection (empty sites or designed templates)
- Wix Editor vs Wix Studio options
- Regular vs Headless site creation
- API endpoint details and parameters
- Post-creation steps (OAuth for headless, publishing for regular sites)
- App installation instructions

## Important Notes

**Do NOT use WixREADME or SearchWixRESTDocumentation before this tool.** If the user wants to create a Wix site, call this tool directly. It contains ALL necessary documentation.

**After reading this documentation:**
1. Use ManageWixSite to create the site
2. Use CallWixSiteAPI to install apps (if needed)

If the user wants to create a Wix site, call this tool directly. It contains ALL necessary documentation. You don't need to search for additional documentation, read more articles, use the WixREADME tool etc unless the user asks you to do so explicitly or you encounter an error.

- METHOD CODE EXAMPLE BASED: BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu() or SearchWixRESTDocumentation() -> find relevant method -> read method article using ReadFullDocsArticle() to get method code examples -> call API using CallWixSiteAPI() based on the method code examples
- FULL SCHEMA BASED: BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu() or SearchWixRESTDocumentation() -> find relevant method -> read method article using ReadFullDocsArticle() -> no method code examples found -> read method schema using ReadFullDocsMethodSchema() -> call API using CallWixSiteAPI() based on the schema
</flow-description>
</agent-mandatory-instructions>

name: Wolfram Alpha Api
description: Integrate computational knowledge into applications via Wolfram|Alpha's APIs.

tools.name: Async Pod Fetch
tools.description: Fetch a single asynchronous pod from Wolfram|Alpha Full Results API. Use this tool to retrieve individual pod computations that were marked as async in a Full Results query. When you query the Full Results API with async=true, pods that take longer to compute return async URLs containing 'id' and 's' tokens. Use those tokens with this tool to fetch the computed pod content. Typical workflow: (1) Query Full Results API with async=true parameter, (2) Parse response for async pod URLs, (3) Extract id and s tokens from URLs like 'asyncPod.jsp?id=MSPa...&s=13', (4) Use this tool with those tokens.

tools.name: Establish Wolfram|Alpha Connection

tools.name: Full Results Recalculate
tools.description: Recalculate a prior WolframAlpha Full Results query to retrieve additional computational results (pods). Use this action when: - A previous Full Results API query timed out or returned incomplete results - You have a recalculate URL or ID token from a previous query - You need to fetch more computational pods from the same query The action requires the 'id' token (obtained from EXTRACT_RECALC_URL_TOKENS or from a Full Results response). The 's' parameter is optional and often not needed. Returns raw XML containing the recalculated query results, which may include additional pods or error information.

tools.name: Full Results Related Queries
tools.description: Tool to fetch related query suggestions for a previous Full Results computation. Use after obtaining `id` and `s` from a Full Results API response.

tools.name: Validate Query
tools.description: Tool to validate a Wolfram|Alpha query, returning parsing assumptions and warnings. Use when you need to check query parse before a full computation.

tools.description: Tool to add a manually specified fact triple (subject-predicate-object) to the Zep knowledge graph. Use when you need to add explicit relationships between entities. Returns a task_id to monitor processing status.

tools.name: Add Session Memory
tools.description: Tool to add memory messages to a specified Zep session. Use when you need to store conversation history or context in a session.

tools.name: Add Thread Messages
tools.description: Tool to add chat messages to a thread in Zep and ingest them into the user knowledge graph. Use when you need to add conversation history to a thread - for best results, add messages on every chat turn in the order they were created.

tools.name: Clone Graph
tools.description: Tool to clone a user or group graph with new identifiers in Zep. Use when you need to create test copies of user data, migrate user graphs to new identifiers, or set up template graphs for new users. This is an asynchronous operation that returns a task_id for tracking progress.

tools.name: Create Graph
tools.description: Tool to create a new graph by adding data to Zep. Use when you need to add text, message, or JSON data to a user's graph or a specific graph. The data is processed and an episode node is created in the graph.

tools.name: Create Group
tools.description: Tool to create a new group in Zep for multi-user graph management. Use when you need to create a namespace for shared context across multiple users.

tools.name: Create Session
tools.description: Tool to create a new session in Zep for storing conversation memory. Use when you need to establish a new conversation context linked to an existing user. The user must be created first before creating a session.

tools.name: Create Thread
tools.description: Tool to create a new thread in Zep for a specific user. Use when you need to start a new conversation thread. The user must be created first before creating a thread. Zep automatically warms the cache for that user's graph data in the background to improve query latency.

tools.name: Create User
tools.description: Tool to create a new user in Zep with properties like user_id, email, and metadata. Use when you need to add a new user to the system. It is recommended to provide at least first_name and ideally last_name for better user association.

tools.name: Delete Graph
tools.description: Tool to delete a graph from Zep. Use when you need to permanently remove a graph and all associated data.

tools.name: Delete Group
tools.description: Tool to delete a group from Zep. Use when you need to permanently remove a group and its associated data.

tools.name: Delete Session Memory
tools.description: Tool to delete a session and its memory from Zep. Use when you need to permanently remove all memory data associated with a specific session.

tools.name: Delete Thread
tools.description: Tool to delete a thread and its messages from Zep. Note that deleting a thread removes the thread and its messages from the thread history but does not delete associated data in the user's knowledge graph.

tools.name: Delete User
tools.description: Tool to delete a user and all associated threads and artifacts from Zep. Use when you need to permanently remove a user and handle Right To Be Forgotten requests. Deleting a user will delete all threads and thread artifacts associated with that user.

tools.name: Get Edge by UUID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific edge by its UUID from the Zep knowledge graph. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a relationship between nodes, including the semantic fact, connected nodes, and temporal metadata.

tools.name: Get Graph by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a graph by its unique identifier from Zep. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific graph including its name, description, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get Group by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a group by ID from Zep. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a specific group including its configuration and metadata.

tools.name: Get Node Entity Edges
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all entity edges for a specific node in the Zep knowledge graph. Use when you need to fetch relationship information, facts, and connections for a given node UUID.

tools.name: Get Project Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve project information based on the provided API key. Use when you need to fetch project details including UUID, name, description, and creation timestamp.

tools.name: Get Session by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a session by its unique identifier from Zep. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific session including user association, timestamps, classifications, and metadata.

tools.name: Get Session Memory
tools.description: Tool to retrieve memory for a given session including relevant facts and entities. Use when you need contextual information and historical data from a session.

tools.name: Get Session Message by UUID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific message by UUID from a Zep session. Use when you need to fetch a single message's details by its unique identifier from a particular session.

tools.name: Get Session Messages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve messages for a given session from Zep. Use when you need to fetch the message history for a specific session with optional pagination support.

tools.name: Get Task Status
tools.description: Tool to check the status of asynchronous operations in Zep. Use when monitoring batch adds, clone operations, or fact triple additions. Returns comprehensive task information including status, progress, timestamps, and error details if applicable.

tools.name: Get Thread Messages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve conversation history for a specific thread from Zep. Use when you need to fetch the chat message history with optional pagination support via limit, cursor, or lastn parameters.

tools.name: Get Thread User Context
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the most relevant user context from the user graph based on thread messages. Use when you need to get context including memory from past threads that is most relevant to the current thread.

tools.name: Get User by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a user by their user ID from Zep. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a specific user including their profile, metadata, and configuration settings.

tools.name: Get User Node
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a user's graph node and summary from Zep. Use when you need to access the user summary generated from instructions, build custom context blocks, or retrieve facts and information associated with a specific user.

tools.name: Get User Nodes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all nodes for a specific user from their graph in Zep. Use when you need to fetch entity information, preferences, and knowledge graph data for a user. Supports pagination via limit and uuid_cursor parameters.

tools.name: Get User Sessions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all sessions for a user from Zep. Use when you need to fetch session history for a specific user ID. Returns an array of session objects with metadata, classifications, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get User Threads
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all threads for a specific user from Zep. Use when you need to fetch thread history for a specific user ID. Returns an array of thread objects with identifiers and timestamps.

tools.name: Graph Search
tools.description: Tool to perform hybrid graph search combining semantic similarity and BM25 full-text search across the Zep knowledge graph. Use when you need to search for entities, relationships, or episodes within a user, group, or specific graph. Supports various reranking methods and filtering options.

tools.name: List Graphs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all graphs from Zep with pagination support. Use when you need to fetch a list of graphs with optional pagination via page_number and page_size parameters.

tools.name: List Groups Ordered
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all groups from Zep with pagination support. Use when you need to fetch a list of groups with optional pagination via pageNumber and pageSize parameters.

tools.name: List Sessions Ordered
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all sessions from Zep with pagination and ordering support. Use when you need to fetch a list of sessions with optional pagination via page_number and page_size parameters.

tools.name: List Threads
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all threads from Zep with pagination support. Use when you need to fetch a list of threads with optional pagination and sorting via page_number, page_size, order_by, and asc parameters.

tools.name: List Users Ordered
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all users from Zep with pagination support. Use when you need to fetch a list of users with optional pagination via pageNumber and pageSize parameters.

tools.name: List All Threads
tools.description: Tool to list all threads with pagination and ordering support. Use when you need to retrieve threads with optional pagination (page_number, page_size) and ordering (order_by, asc) parameters.

tools.name: Update Graph
tools.description: Tool to update graph information in Zep including name and description. Use when you need to modify graph properties after creation.

tools.name: Update Group
tools.description: Tool to update group information in Zep including name, description, and fact rating instructions. Use when you need to modify an existing group's properties.

tools.name: Update Message
tools.description: Tool to update a message in a Zep thread. Use when you need to modify message content, metadata, role, or other properties of an existing message. Particularly useful for adding or modifying metadata after a message has been created.

tools.name: Update Session Metadata
tools.description: Tool to update session metadata in Zep. Use when you need to modify or add metadata to an existing session. Metadata is merged, so existing keys are preserved unless explicitly overwritten.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Tool to update an existing user's information in Zep including email, metadata, and ontology settings. Use when you need to modify user properties after creation.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Zep API key. For Zep Cloud, create an API key in Project Settings under Project Keys. Keys starting with "z_" use Api-Key format, others use Bearer format.

name: Zeplin
description: Zeplin is a design delivery platform that connects designers and developers, enabling access to design resources like projects, screens, components, and assets.

tools.name: Start OAuth authorization (PKCE)
tools.description: Tool to start OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow for Zeplin apps. Use when initiating user authorization; call before exchanging the code.

tools.name: List Project Connected Components
tools.description: Tool to list connected components in a Zeplin project. Use when you have the project_id and need to retrieve connected components in a specific project.

tools.name: List Project Colors
tools.description: Tool to list colors in a Zeplin project. Use when you need to fetch defined color tokens at the project level after obtaining the project ID.

tools.name: Update Project Color
tools.description: Tool to update a color in a Zeplin project. Use when you need to modify RGBA channels or source ID of an existing color after confirming the project and color IDs.

tools.name: Get Zeplin Project by ID
tools.description: Tool to get a Zeplin project by ID. Use when you need detailed info about a specific project after confirming its project_id.

tools.name: Invite Project Member
tools.description: Tool to invite a user to a Zeplin project. Use when you need to add a member by email or username to a project after obtaining the project ID.

tools.name: List Project Text Styles
tools.description: Tool to list text styles in a Zeplin project. Use when you need to fetch typography tokens defined at the project level after obtaining the project ID.

tools.name: Update Project Text Style
tools.description: Tool to update a text style in a Zeplin project. Use when you need to modify typography settings of an existing text style after confirming the project and text style IDs.

tools.name: Delete Screen Annotation
tools.description: Tool to delete a screen annotation in Zeplin. Use when you need to remove a specific annotation from a Zeplin screen given its IDs.

tools.name: Get Screen Annotation
tools.description: Tool to fetch a single screen annotation. Use when you know the screen_id and annotation_id and need the detailed annotation data.

tools.name: List Screen Annotations
tools.description: Tool to list annotations for a Zeplin screen. Use when you have the screen_id and need its annotations.

tools.name: Update Screen Annotation
tools.description: Tool to update a screen annotation's content, position, or type. Use after confirming screen_id and annotation_id.

tools.name: List Screen Components
tools.description: Tool to list components in a Zeplin screen. Use when you have the screen_id and need to retrieve UI components in a specific screen.

tools.name: Get Screen Section
tools.description: Tool to get a single screen section. Use when you need to fetch detailed information of a screen section by its ID after confirming the project and section IDs.

tools.name: List Screen Sections
tools.description: Tool to list screen sections in a Zeplin project. Use when you need a paginated list of screen sections after confirming the project ID.

tools.name: Get Screen Version
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific screen version. Use after specifying both screen_id and version_id when you need detailed snapshot metadata.

tools.name: Create Screen Version
tools.description: Tool to create a new version of a screen. Use when uploading a new design snapshot (PNG or JPEG image) as a screen version. Requires a valid project_id, screen_id, and an image file. Optionally include a commit_message.

tools.name: List Screen Versions
tools.description: Tool to list all versions of a screen. Use when you need to enumerate past screen snapshots after obtaining a screen ID.

tools.name: Create Styleguide Color
tools.description: Tool to create a new styleguide color. Use after obtaining the styleguide ID to define custom color tokens.

tools.name: List Styleguide Colors
tools.description: Tool to list colors in a Zeplin styleguide. Use when you need to fetch defined color tokens after obtaining the styleguide ID.

tools.name: Update Styleguide Color
tools.description: Tool to update a color in a Zeplin styleguide. Use after obtaining the styleguide and color IDs.

tools.name: List Styleguide Text Styles
tools.description: Tool to list text styles in a Zeplin styleguide. Use when you need to fetch defined typography tokens after obtaining the styleguide ID.

tools.name: Update Styleguide Text Style
tools.description: Tool to update a text style in a Zeplin styleguide. Use when you need to modify typography settings of an existing text style after confirming the styleguide and text style IDs.

tools.name: List Personal Projects
tools.description: Tool to list personal projects. Use when you need to fetch all projects in the current user's personal workspace after authentication.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Zeplin Personal Access Token. Generate it from your Zeplin profile under the Developer tab.

name: Zerobounce
description: ZeroBounce is an email validation and deliverability platform that helps businesses improve email marketing performance by identifying and removing invalid or risky email addresses.

tools.name: Get Activity Data
tools.description: Tool to get activity data (opens, clicks, etc.) for a given email. Use after confirming the email address to gauge engagement recency.

tools.name: AI Scoring Single Email
tools.description: Tool to score a single email address using ZeroBounce AI. Use when you need real-time email lead quality feedback before outreach. Example prompt: "Score the email mark@gmail.com."

tools.name: Allow or Block List
tools.description: Tool to manage allowlist and blocklist for email validation. Use when you need to programmatically add or modify custom filters before validating emails.

tools.name: Batch Validate Emails
tools.description: Tool to validate a batch of email addresses in real time. Use when you need to validate up to 200 emails at once with optional activity data.

tools.name: Delete file
tools.description: Tool to delete a file that was submitted for bulk validation. Use when file status is 'Complete'.

tools.name: Domain Search File Status
tools.description: Tool to get the processing status of a file submitted for bulk domain search. Use after submitting the file to poll status.

tools.name: Domain Search Get File
tools.description: Tool to download the results file for a completed bulk domain search job. Use when you have the file_id and the job is complete.

tools.name: Domain Search Send File
tools.description: Tool to upload a file for bulk domain search. Use when you have many domains in a CSV/TXT and need to lookup their details in bulk.

tools.name: Domain Search Single
tools.description: Tool to identify common email address formats for a given domain. Use when you need to guess email patterns for a company based on its domain.

tools.name: Delete Email Finder File
tools.description: Tool to delete a file that was submitted for bulk email finding. Use when the file processing status is 'Complete' and you need to remove it.

tools.name: Email Finder File Status
tools.description: Tool to get the processing status of a file submitted for bulk email finding. Use when you need to poll the progress of a bulk email-finder file upload.

tools.name: Email Finder Send File
tools.description: Tool to upload a file for bulk email finding. Use when you have lists of names and domains to find emails in bulk via CSV/TXT upload.

tools.name: Email Finder Single
tools.description: Tool to find an email address for a given person and domain. Use when you need to locate a professional email from a person's name and company domain. Use after confirming domain or company info.

tools.name: Get API Usage
tools.description: Tool to retrieve API usage statistics for a given period. Use when you need usage metrics between two dates.

tools.name: Get Credit Balance
tools.description: Tool to retrieve your current ZeroBounce email validation credit balance. Use when you need to monitor remaining credits to avoid service interruptions.

tools.name: List Evaluator
tools.description: Tool to evaluate the quality of an email list. Use when you have a list of emails and need a quick health check before full validation.

tools.name: Send File
tools.description: Tool to upload a file for bulk email validation. Use when you need to validate large lists of emails via CSV or TXT file.

tools.name: Validate Email
tools.description: Tool to validate a single email address in real time. Use when you need to confirm deliverability and domain details before sending emails.

required.name: full
required.description: The base URL for the ZeroBounce API.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your API Key, found in your ZeroBounce account under API Keys & Info.

name: Zylvie
description: High-converting cart software for solopreneurs to sell digital products and subscriptions.

tools.name: Create Product
tools.description: Tool to create a new product. Use when you need to add a product with detailed custom options in Zylvie platform.

tools.name: Get Authenticating User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the currently authenticated user. Use when you have a valid Bearer token and need to fetch the authenticated user's profile.

tools.name: Unsubscribe Webhook
tools.description: Tool to unsubscribe from a webhook by deleting the workflow object associated with the specified webhook URL. Use after confirming the webhook URL to remove.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Zylvie API key, found under your Settings > API page.

name: Zyte Api
description: Zyte API is a web scraping solution that automates data extraction from websites, handling challenges like bans and dynamic content.

tools.name: Fetch Active Scheduled Maintenances
tools.description: Retrieves currently active scheduled maintenances that are in 'In Progress' or 'Verifying' state. Use this to check for ongoing maintenance events that may affect Zyte API availability. Returns an empty list if no maintenances are currently active.

tools.name: Zyte API Components
tools.description: Retrieves all Zyte service components with their current operational status. Returns component details including status (operational, degraded_performance, partial_outage, major_outage), descriptions, groupings, and metadata. Useful for monitoring service health and identifying issues. No parameters required - provides a real-time snapshot of all Zyte infrastructure components.

tools.name: Get scheduled maintenances
tools.description: Tool to get the 50 most recent scheduled maintenances (upcoming and completed) from Zyte status API. Use after confirming you need the latest maintenance schedule for monitoring.

tools.name: Zyte API: Get Unresolved Incidents
tools.description: Tool to retrieve unresolved incidents from Zyte status API. Use when you need to check currently open incidents.

tools.name: List Zyte API status incidents
tools.description: Retrieves the 50 most recent incidents from the Zyte API status page, including both resolved and unresolved incidents. Use this tool to check current API health, review incident history, or get detailed information about service disruptions affecting Zyte services.

tools.name: Get Zyte API Status Rollup
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive operational status for all Zyte services. Returns current status of components (Zyte API, Smart Proxy Manager, Scrapy Cloud, etc.), active incidents, and scheduled maintenance windows. Use this to check service health before making API calls or to diagnose issues.

tools.name: Zyte Status Summary
tools.description: Retrieves a comprehensive summary of Zyte's service status including overall status indicators, individual component statuses (e.g., Web Dashboard, Smart Proxy Manager, Scrapy Cloud, Zyte API), active incidents, and scheduled maintenance windows. This provides a complete overview of the current health and availability of all Zyte services. No parameters required - simply call to get the latest status information.

tools.name: Upcoming Scheduled Maintenances
tools.description: Tool to retrieve upcoming scheduled maintenance windows. Use when you need to list upcoming maintenance events from the Zyte API status page.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Zyte API key used for authentication. Find it at https://app.zyte.com/o/zyte-api/api-access.
